Brace gives you two versions of your website, a Draft version and a Production version. The Draft is for iteration and collaboration. The Production version is optimized for performance and scale.

yc_dreamforge.name: Dreamforge
yc_dreamforge.description: We believe that 3D printing will fundamentally reshape our relationship with the products and items we use. At Dreamforge, we'll strive to show our beliefs in big ways and small in the products we build and in the example we set.

yc_collections.name: Collections
yc_collections.description: Collections is a cross-platform personal content manager built for the age of cloud computing. It gives you access to everything you have stored in cloud services like Dropbox and Google Drive and in web apps like Facebook and Instagram, as well as your local files. As a universal finder for the cloud, Collections lets you bring together all of your most important digital content, helping you to regain control over your online presence. What would Apple's Finder look like if it were invented today, rather than in 1983? Collections is an Internet-age personal content manager, a fundamental reinvention of the file manager that lets you easily access and organize all of the digital content you

yc_filestack.name: FileStack
yc_filestack.tagline: Acquired by Xenon Ventures.We enable website developers to hook into…
yc_filestack.description: Filestack helps 100,000 apps access, personalize and embed end user content, all in one API. Filestack handles all steps in a company's file journey while providing custom built machine learning models and enhanced upload reliability to deliver the ultimate content experience. We are culturally diverse with folks from Canada, IE, Poland, Ukraine, South Africa, India, Boston, Colorado, and North Carolina.

yc_hipset.name: Hipset
yc_hipset.tagline: The best way for artists to release new music and videos.
yc_hipset.description: The best way for artists to release new music and videos.

yc_kippt.name: Kippt
yc_kippt.tagline: Kippt is a social bookmarking service
yc_kippt.description: Kippt is a collaborative bookmarking system for professional networks that lets employees teach and share with each other on a dedicated platform. When you collect something to Kippt, the page and the content will be searchable, organizable, readable on your devices and easily shared with other people.

yc_hiptype.name: Hiptype
yc_hiptype.tagline: Hiptype is a marketing and analytics platform for eBooks. We can…
yc_hiptype.description: Hiptype brings analytics and targeted advertising capabilities to the most popular eBook platforms, where these powerful features have never before been possible. Hiptype's patent-pending plugin for books captures demographic and book performance data that can be used to power in-book targeted advertising and automated book marketing campaign optimizations. Hiptype's founding team has previously designed and engineered products at Google, Turntable.fm, and mobile advertising platform Chartboost.

yc_markupwand.name: Markupwand
yc_markupwand.tagline: Convert Design files to working websites automagically
yc_markupwand.description: A product that takes PSD files and generates HTML / CSS automatically, and asks a few questions to generate the view templates with a few simple inputs from a backend developer.

yc_crohnology-by-healthy-labs.name: Crohnology (by Healthy Labs)
yc_crohnology-by-healthy-labs.description: Crohnology is a global online symptom and health tracking network of over 27,000 patients with Crohn’s & Ulcerative Colitis. Performed research collaborations with University of North Carolina, the Crohn’s & Colitis Foundation of America, Genentech, and Qu Biologics among others.

yc_datanitro.name: DataNitro
yc_datanitro.description: DataNitro integrates Excel with Python. It's the easiest way to get data in to and out of Excel, to automate your workflow, and to run sophisticated mathematical, statistical, or financial calculations in your spreadsheet.

yc_lendup.name: LendUp
yc_lendup.tagline: LendUp is a socially responsible company on a mission to redefine…
yc_lendup.description: Could a fintech company be built that helps people today, and prepares them for tomorrow? One that offers consumers high quality, mobile-first credit and savings products and protects them from tricks and traps? That’s LendUp. LendUp's mission is to provide anyone with a better path to financial health. We believe there are two types of financial products: chutes and ladders. Ladders help people up, chutes push people down. One of our core values is that every product we offer at LendUp is a ladder, measured by the long-term financial well-being of our customers. LendUp credit cards, loans, and savings resources reflect our commitment to getting our customers to a better financial state. We

yc_framebase.name: Framebase
yc_framebase.description: Framebase is programmatic video. Writing applications which use video in a meaningful way is extremely difficult. And then there's the maintenance. Framebase makes video a first-class object. Instead of hiring a team to deal with transcoding configurations, device compatibility bugs, or CDN contracts, Framebase lets you add two lines of code to start treating videos as class instances. Framebase is a pivot of TapIn.tv, which is a Y Combinator S 2012 company.

yc_testmunk.name: Testmunk
yc_testmunk.description: Test your app on a large pool of Android and iOS versions and devices. No need to constantly buy and upgrade your devices. Testmunk ensures complete device and OS coverage currently available on the market. Devices are non-jailbroken. We support native and hybrid apps.

yc_imgfave.name: Imgfave
yc_imgfave.description: imgfave is a place to discover and share images. They allow users to collect favorite images and organize them into fun collections like humor, art, photography, fashion, weddings and more.

yc_leanmarket.name: LeanMarket
yc_leanmarket.description: LeanMarket discovers the highest performing placements of advertising that allows users to build an ideal campaign based off in-depth reporting.

yc_canopy-labs.name: Canopy Labs
yc_canopy-labs.tagline: Canopy Labs automates customer analytics for small and medium-sized…
yc_canopy-labs.description: Every customer reaches a buying decision in their unique way – Canopy Labs helps businesses to track and optimize their customer journey. Using our platform, businesses can plan more targeted marketing campaigns and optimize their lead lists, with a focus on maximizing revenue and sales growth. Our platform is currently being used in a variety of industries, including sports, ticket sales, daily deals, and online retail, and customers ranging from $10B retailers to small online businesses. Canopy Labs has offices in Toronto and New York City. The company is led by CEO Wojciech Gryc, who is a former McKinsey consultant and Rhodes Scholar, and CTO Jorge Escobedo, who has a PhD in Theoretical P

yc_grouper.name: Grouper
yc_grouper.tagline: We set up drinks between 2 groups of friends: 3 guys and 3 girls.
yc_grouper.description: Grouper is a social club that sets up drinks between 2 groups of friends: 3 guys and 3 girls (or 3 guys and 3 guys, etc.). Grouper started in New York in the summer of 2011 and now organizes Groupers in major cities across the US. Members have shared tens of thousands of drinks. The company was founded by Michael Waxman, a Yale grad and developer who formerly started language-learning company Batiq, and Tom Brown, an MIT engineer who was an early employee at MoPub (acquired by Twitter for 350MM). The founding team also includes Challen Hodson and Kristen Badal. Grouper was funded by Y Combinator in the Winter 2012 batch.

yc_tomoguides.name: TomoGuides
yc_tomoguides.tagline: Mobile travel guides done right. Personalized, context-aware, and…
yc_tomoguides.description: Handcrafted iPhone travel guides that are free, offline, and just plain full of awesomeness.

yc_infogami.name: Infogami
yc_infogami.description: What is Infogami? The art of transforming data into meaningful information. Infogami Business Intelligence (BI) solutions turn raw data into information that enables businesses to gain insights, improve decision making, reduce costs and support strategic objectives. Subject matter expertise is central to the Infogami ethos. The ability to communicate effectively and understand requirements, separates Infogami from other BI solutions. Bridging the gap between information and collaboration, Infogami solutions enhance collaborative decision making and interaction. This improves the communication and information sharing process within an organisation.

yc_audiobeta.name: Audiobeta
yc_audiobeta.description: AudioBeta develops web-based applications that helps bands communicate with fans and make informed decisions when planning tours. AudioBeta is a U.S.-based company that was founded in 2006 by Altay Guvench.

yc_flagr.name: Flagr
yc_flagr.description: Flagr enables users to share places, adding photos, video and descriptions from their mobile phone. They can then create maps and embed them on any website.

yc_zillabyte.name: Zillabyte
yc_zillabyte.description: Zillabyte is a cloud platform for data analysis. Build apps, not infrastructure. We set up and maintain the infrastructure you need to analyze your data. All you need to do is develop your app locally and test it using the our CLI. When you need to scale, push to our servers. Easily add more functionality with components, modular code blocks that let you perform additional functions such as: geo coding, fraud analysis, and web scraping. Use your own private datasets or plug into our off-the-shelf data, which includes a copy of the web. You can even combine the two and extract rich insights.

yc_snipshot.name: Snipshot
yc_snipshot.tagline: We sold Snipshot to Ansa in 2013.
yc_snipshot.description: Snipshot is a photo editor that lets you start editing any photo with one click of a bookmarklet. You can use Snipshot to crop, resize, adjust colors, an automatically enhance you photos within your browser and then save it back to the web. There are a couple other photo editors in this category and Photoshop plans to get in as well.

yc_jumpchat.name: Jumpchat
yc_jumpchat.description: A platform bridging mobile text messages, email, and IM communication without needing to download anything. Users can send mass messages on any of the platforms and JumpChat will send it to the platform the receiver activates. They are currently focusing on mass mobile messaging, where users can shoot off mass messages to the groups they define.

yc_likebetter.name: Likebetter
yc_likebetter.description: An online personality test game, where you look at two photos and choose which one you “Like Better”.

yc_zanbazaar.name: Zanbazaar
yc_zanbazaar.description: Anyone can create their own beautiful catalog pages of products that they want to editorialize and recommend to others. Authors earn a portion of the referral bonus for products sold. Shut down in 2007.

yc_pollground.name: Pollground
yc_pollground.description: A social polling site. Pollground allows you to easily create surveys and allow the “wisdom of the crowd” to answer your questions. Questions and comments can be posted anonymously.

yc_shoutfit.name: Shoutfit
yc_shoutfit.description: We tried to build a social network around clothing. Also briefly built a search engine for clothing.

yc_talkray-tikl.name: Talkray (TiKL)
yc_talkray-tikl.tagline: Instantly talk or text to one or a group of friends at once with the…
yc_talkray-tikl.description: Turn your smart phone into the ultimate push to talk walkie-talkie with TiKL. App available in Android Market and iPhone App Store. Its free.

yc_jamglue.name: Jamglue
yc_jamglue.description: Jamglue is an online community allowing users to listen or mix music from a library of user-contributed music.

yc_socialmoth.name: Socialmoth
yc_socialmoth.description: Socialmoth is a community to post your thoughts anonymously. You can view postings (mostly gossip and secrets) from the whole community as well as get updates for when someone in your group of friends makes a post. The vast majority of their members appear to be women, with over 600 posts being made per day. These guys will also be taking a new spin on their idea, launching Disenchat.com, a place to post anonymously about your workplace. The system will verify your organization by email address (like Facebook) and let you start riffing. Outsiders will be able to see the existence of the forum and volume of posting, but not the specific comments.

yc_view3.name: View3
yc_view3.description: View 3, an active clad-alignment splicer with the world's highest fiber image magnification rate, is the most dependable fusion splicer.

yc_whitenoise.name: Whitenoise
yc_whitenoise.description: Whitenoise is like a social network for the music industry. It comes with specially made tools for bands, agents, publicists, and venues to manage each part of their business. Bands will be able to manage their cross country tours by map, using a venue search to find gigs in any town they're passing through. Venues will get access to a full list of artists in their area along with samples and ways to reach their agent to book a show.

yc_writewith.name: WriteWith
yc_writewith.description: Writewith is a collaborative writing web app, enabling you to easily flow through the steps of writing, editing, and publishing a document with a group. A document is started by uploading an existing document (.doc, .txt, .rdf) or just typing away. After the initial draft is completed, you can invite other editors by email and assign them tasks. Writewith has full version control and even lets you post comments to each other, making it possible to edit together in real time. Currently Writewith is in beta testing with 15 college newspapers including Stanford and two of Canada's largest college papers (which even includes a national newswire).

yc_tsumobi.name: Tsumobi
yc_tsumobi.description: Mobile applications have so far been nightmares to implement. It's often hard to gain adoption due to complicated installs and near impossible to get users to upgrade their version once the product has shipped. Tsumobi hopes to solve this problem by creating their own language. The new language will sit on top of J2ME and process applications downloaded (via URL) for Tsumobi enabled sites. This means that developers will be able to change Tsumobi applications on the fly and have Tsumobi enabled phones automatically get the updates just by visiting a link.

yc_fuzzwich.name: Fuzzwich
yc_fuzzwich.description: Fuzzwich is an online animation platform developed by Habit Industries.

yc_pixelapse.name: Pixelapse
yc_pixelapse.tagline: Github for designers. We automatically keep track of revisions of…
yc_pixelapse.description: Pixelapse is the best place to share designs and work together. We build tools to improve the design process and make collaboration easier. Pixelapse simplifies version control and makes it accessible for designers to share and discuss their work with their friends, colleagues and the world.

yc_reble.name: Reble
yc_reble.description: Reble offers a software download, only for windows, that allows users to stream music from your friends who also have installed Reble. It launched into public beta on Feb. 5th, 2008, and is a Y Combinator-funded company.

yc_socialpicks.name: SocialPicks
yc_socialpicks.tagline: SocialPicks was a platform where stock investors could exchange…

yc_contestmachine.name: ContestMachine
yc_contestmachine.tagline: Roll your own contest or giveaway. No longer in business.
yc_contestmachine.description: ContestMachine is a web service that makes running promotions from any website easy. The service allows clients to run a contest or giveaway from their blog or website and handles the rest of the details, like collecting submissions and contacting winners. The service also allows clients varied options, like choosing entry requirements, start and end times, and the addition of prizes.

yc_splashup.name: Splashup
yc_splashup.description: Splashup, formerly known as fauxto, is an online image editing service that provides some advanced tools and is unique for its incorporation of image editing layer effects. The site is still in beta, and so does not offer full editing capabilities yet.

yc_ijigg-top440.name: iJigg/Top440
yc_ijigg-top440.description: iJigg is a social music site that lets users vote on submitted singles using Digg-like voting. The site's home page shows what popular or recent singles the iJigg community is "jigging." Users can rate songs, embed songs on MySpace or find similar music fans. Competitors include Contrastream. Social music competitors include FineTune, Last.fm, Pandora and iLike.

yc_make-school.name: Make School
yc_make-school.tagline: Make School is redesigning college for the 21st century. Students…
yc_make-school.description: Make School is redesigning college for the 21st century. Our bachelor's degree program combines liberal arts, computer science theory, software development, and character development with an emphasis on preparing students for successful careers as software engineers, product managers, or entrepreneurs. Our alumni work at Facebook, Google, Apple, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Lyft and more. Our college is accessible to students of all backgrounds, 40% are underrepresented minority students and 50% come from low income families. Students pay tuition as a percentage of earnings once they are employed, directly aligning their incentives with ours. Make School is funded by Learn Capital, Y Combinator, Mitc

yc_hello-chair.name: Hello Chair
yc_hello-chair.description: Hello, Chair Inc. was founded in 2006 by Luke Iannini, Mike Jacobs and Kevin Corcoran to explore opportunities in applied machine learning and internet advertising. After receiving funding from Y-Combinator in 2007, we produced Adpinion, one of the first advertising networks to utilize user feedback to drive personalized targeting. Our core technology — the recommendation engine called SparseReduce — has since proved infinitely adaptable in such diverse problem domains as Amazon product recommendation, eBay auction discovery, image and language comprehension, and Twitter stream exploration. The latest application of SparseReduce is Appsaurus, an app discovery platform which was released on t

yc_bountii.name: Bountii
yc_bountii.description: Bountii is a price search startup that has built a search engine capable of finding shoppers lower and more accurate prices than any existing price comparison service. Currently supplying consumers with pricing information on electronics and appliances, Bountii aims to expand its service to make buying any product online at the best price an effortless experience. Bountii was founded in the Summer of 2007 by Samir Meghani and John Puskarich. Initial investment was provided by Y Combinator, a venture firm that specializes in funding early stage startups.

yc_joberator.name: Joberator
yc_joberator.description: Joberator was formed to tackle head-on the growing challenges and connection-gap issues in the STEM employment and recruitment marketplace. Our goal is to help the right talent and right employers connect together through accelerated, streamlined and STEM-specialized search / matching tools and features. With a Centralized end-to-end platform where Graduates and Professionals can showcase their skills, plus access a unique connection-pipeline that empowers job seekers at all levels and in every Science, Technology, Engineering and Math fields - to 'Pinpoint' the right businesses who have the highest STEM employment and hiring demand for their skills, thus creating improved and increased hiri

yc_snaptalent.name: Snaptalent
yc_snaptalent.description: Snaptalent powers a distributed job advertisement network primarily meant for developer listings. Job ads submitted to Snaptalent are displayed on the service's participating websites. A unique feature about the network is that it will detect the IP addresses of website visitors and attempt to identify whether they work for a particular company or attend a particular university. It will then serve up targeted ads that have been designated for, say, employees of Google or students of Carnegie Mellon.

yc_yumdots.name: YumDots
yc_yumdots.description: YumDots wants to be the go-to mobile application for finding places to eat when out on the town. Its emphasis on using interactive maps to display information about local restaurants makes it more efficient than other mobile review services like Yelp's. The service is launching soon.

yc_deluux.name: Deluux
yc_deluux.description: Deluux aims to become distributed Facebook, or inverted Ning, by relocating the center of people's online identities to their websites, which exist outside of any one social network. The service will facilitate the distribution of personalized content around the web and help drive traffic to websites. It has yet to launch.

yc_kirkland-north.name: Kirkland North
yc_kirkland-north.description: Kirkland North is taking an infectious campus-wide game that it ran at Yale and Harvard last year and spreading it to other campuses around the country. The game, called Turf, pits sections of campuses against each other in a virtual battle for university-wide domination. The founders are currently rolling out individual versions of their online game as a service for institutions including Stanford and Harvard.

yc_tipjoy.name: Tipjoy
yc_tipjoy.description: Tipjoy was a simple, social payments engine that allowed merchants to sell digital content and features, charities to raise money for causes, and individuals to give money to one another. Tipjoy was a Winter '08 Y Combinator participant.

yc_mixwit.name: Mixwit
yc_mixwit.tagline: Online mixtape service (create and share mixtapes). Launched as part…
yc_mixwit.description: Mixwit describes itself as a combination of Slide and iTunes. While it has more ambitious plans, it currently provides an easy way to make sharable mix tapes with songs found through MP3 search engines Seeqpod and Skreamr.

yc_socialbrowse.name: Socialbrowse
yc_socialbrowse.description: SocialBrowse is a Firefox extension for sharing links. It has been described as "a Twitter for links".

yc_wundrbar.name: Wundrbar
yc_wundrbar.description: Wundrbar wants to improve upon the search bar experience by providing users with powerful inline commands. The idea is reminiscent of YubNub but Wundrbar strives to appeal to a larger audience and to incorporate functionality that helps people manage their personal online accounts in addition to searching the web.

yc_fathomdb.name: FathomDB
yc_fathomdb.description: FathomDB offers databases as a service, taking care of many of the day-to-day tasks database administrators have to deal with and letting them focus on more complex issues.

yc_mightyquiz.name: MightyQuiz
yc_mightyquiz.description: MightyQuiz powers a collection of user generated quiz questions that can be answered and rated on-site or through a distributable widget.

yc_trigger.name: Trigger
yc_trigger.description: Trigger makes the $15Bn mobile application market accessible by web developers. It's the simplest way to build amazing mobile apps using the best of HTML5 and native. Trigger has raised $1.8M in seed funding from top Silicon Valley investors including Y Combinator and SV Angel.

yc_slinkset.name: Slinkset
yc_slinkset.description: Slinkset is a white label social news platform that allows anyone to start a social news site and integrate it into their own website.

yc_treehouse.name: Treehouse
yc_treehouse.description: Treehouse is an online technology school that offers beginner to advanced courses in web design, web development, mobile development and game development taught by a team of expert teachers. Its courses are aimed at beginners looking to learn coding skills and embark on a career in the tech industry. In May 2016, Treehouse launched the Techdegree program, a comprehensive learning program focused on helping people learn the skills they need to start a tech career. Through earning a Techdegree certification, a student will challenge themselves, deepen their skills, and prove their knowledge to potential employers. All in 6-12 months, on their own schedule. Treehouse believes that understanding

yc_people-and-pages.name: People & Pages
yc_people-and-pages.description: People and Pages is a service similar to Google Groups, allowing group organizers to manage email lists and publish to the web in one place. Although the screenshots show that it's part WYSIWYG website creation tool as well, making it competitive with Google Sites, Weebly, and others. As of August 2008 the site is yet to launch.

yc_popcuts.name: Popcuts
yc_popcuts.tagline: Popcuts is an online music store where fans participate in the…
yc_popcuts.description: Popcuts is a unique online music store. DRM-free songs are sold for 99cents, but every time a song you bought sells, you get a cut of the proceeds (earlier buyers get a bigger cut).

yc_snipd.name: Snipd
yc_snipd.description: Grab pieces of enjoyable content from any page, save them online, and share without having to copy/paste using a simple bookmarklet. For bloggers and media sites, Snipd's widget enables readership to Snip images, videos, or text enjoyed most within articles. Snipd content becomes a destination for users, rather than a list of bookmarks because users are able to enjoy what they saved from within pages on the net. With more and more content to sift through these days, Snipd makes it easier to identify hot-zones in articles. Hot-zones are dumbed-down heat maps for content. Readers can forget skimming and focus on what people are Snipping most on any page. Because a snip is an implicit vote on a

yc_ticket-stumbler.name: Ticket Stumbler
yc_ticket-stumbler.description: TicketStumbler is a secondary ticket market search engine and comparison website. They search through thousands of ticket listings from hundreds of brokers and ticket exchanges across the internet and present the information in an organizable format. TicketStumbler allows simple ticket comparison, enabling you to find the best seats at the best prices.

yc_team-apart.name: Team Apart
yc_team-apart.description: Team Apart is a real-time online group collaboration tool.

yc_youlicit.name: Youlicit
yc_youlicit.description: The Youlicit web content recommendation engine leverages the wisdom of the crowds to return the most recommended sites related to a website or topic. To use Youlicit, simply install a plug-in with the Youlicit buttons on your Firefox browser. These buttons light up, while you surf, and by clicking on them, you instantly get highly relevant recommendations, without searching. It also allows you to discover the web via personalized recommendations based on your interests and find other users interested in the same topics as you.

yc_picwing.name: Picwing
yc_picwing.description: Picwing is a photo sharing platform that enables users to share their photos through a variety of sources. Picwing offers a convenient printing service where their users can send photos through email using a camera or computer. These photos are printed and mailed to one or more recipients every 2 weeks. Picwing also provides digital photo frames built upon a Linux kernel. Users can send an image from their desktop or phone, and within 20-30 seconds see it on a digital frame. The frames are mini Linux machines that the founders hope will eventually be able to support much more than image sharing.

yc_co2stats.name: CO2Stats
yc_co2stats.tagline: Social and environmental web analytics. Acquired in December 2016.
yc_co2stats.description: CO2Stats aims to help website owners understand the electricity usage and related carbon emissions associated with site usage, and then helps site owners manage their carbon footprint. The company calculates the greenhouse gas footprint of visits to your site, based on locations of your visitors and servers, computer types, window and monitor sizes, local fuel mixes, download sizes and times. Every month CO2Stats purchase Green-E certified Renewable Energy Certificates to offset your site's CO2 footprint. Users can inspect your certificates and other environmental statistics by clicking on your CO2Stats badge.

yc_anyvite.name: Anyvite
yc_anyvite.description: Anyvite is a free site dedicated to event invitation creation and group organization. Launched in 2008, Anyvite provides users with the most efficient way to create invitations as well as offers the tools necessary to organize and communicate with attendees throughout the event lifecycle.

yc_frogmetrics.name: Frogmetrics
yc_frogmetrics.description: Frogmetrics aggregates your data from unlimited locations, automatically finds the most important statistics, and helps you gain insights about your business from your web browser. The company wants to place touch screens in restaurants, stores, and other brick and mortar establishments that can be used to collect customer feedback on the spot. The devices ask customers a few questions at the point of sale about their experience and can collect contact information about customers to generate leads. The information gathered across physical locations is aggregated and analyzed for trends and other statistics.

yc_ohlife.name: OhLife
yc_ohlife.description: OhLife is a personal journal that you'll actually keep. Every day we send you an email asking "How'd your day go?" You type as much as you want and hit reply. We accumulate your entire journal through these daily email replies.

yc_voxli.name: Voxli
yc_voxli.description: Voxli offers browser-based group voice chat for gamers and teams. Users of Voxli can voice chat with up to 200 people at a time without leaving the browser or setting up a voice server. Each group voice chat exists at a persistent URL, which can be shared with friends via email or IM. Voxli works on Windows and Mac, and supports push-to-talk (walkie talkie) functionality outside of the browser. Voxli is currently free while it is in open beta.

yc_nambii.name: Nambii
yc_nambii.description: Nambii is an online dating service with iPhone applications that allow users to send and receive flirts with people around them.

yc_picurio.name: Picurio
yc_picurio.description: Picurio is web-based photo sharing and photo management software.

yc_minefold.name: Minefold
yc_minefold.description: Simple to set up, on demand game servers. Minefold runs game servers for popular games such as Minecraft and Team Fortress 2. Servers can be created and running in under 30 seconds and players pay by the hour.

yc_foodoro.name: Foodoro
yc_foodoro.description: Foodoro is a marketplace where people can buy specialty food directly from artisanal Foodmakers Our goal is to help people discover amazing food products and connect them with the folks who make their food Our company was started in 2008 by a small group of folks obsessed with food and technology People were always telling us about small Foodmakers who make amazing products, but we found it difficult to get our hands on their food. So, we decided to build a better way to help people discover and buy the best food products anywhere

yc_wattvision.name: Wattvision
yc_wattvision.tagline: Sensors and software for energy tracking. Like 'fitbit' for your…
yc_wattvision.description: Wattvision offers a simple idea: Monitor your energy consumption in realtime from the web. We started by selling the complete sensor and software solution, and now we are focusing on developing software that works with our hardware partners.

yc_skysheet.name: Skysheet
yc_skysheet.description: Skysheet is a web-based spreadsheet, in stealth mode as of March 2009.

yc_recurious.name: Recurious
yc_recurious.description: thesixtyone is Digg for new music, a social filter for the tsunami of indie creativity hitting the web. Like Digg, the homepage is community driven. Listeners who sign up are given a daily number of "hearts" they can use to vote on songs they like. If songs you heart become popular, you earn reputation points, level up, and unlock community abilities. Listeners can also earn achievement badges for various activities, like hearting songs in under-explored genres or reaching a playcount milestone. All tracks are fully streamable and can be organized in tag-based playlists. To lubricate the experience, they've invented an ajax navigation system that allows listeners to enjoy seamless audio play

yc_instantq.name: Instantq
yc_instantq.description: InstantQ is an online platform that enables restaurants to distribute JIT promotions to its customers. It was launched in 2009 by Dana Levine and is based in California.

yc_wakemate.name: Wakemate
yc_wakemate.description: WakeMate makes personalized alarm clocks that sync with both a user's body and their cell phone, enabling the iPhone alarm system to sound at the end of a REM cycle. The application/ wristband system also provides a full sleep analysis on their Analytics Platform. The WakeMate uses a science called actigraphy to analyze your sleep. Actigraphy uses an actigraph (the WakeMate unit) placed on a subjectâ€™s wrist to monitor the motion. The motion data is then analyzed to determine sleep patterns and circadian rhythms of the subject. WakeMate was funded by the startup incubator Y Combinator.

yc_marft.name: Marft
yc_marft.tagline: Marft creates embeddable machine learning models for application…
yc_marft.description: Marft creates embeddable machine learning models for application developers. Users submit data by web/API, and receive optimized models implemented in a language of their choice.

We seek technical experts in enzyme engineering, chemistry, hardware engineering, and information theory. We use patented bioMEMS technology to turn cell strength (cells' ability to pull/ squeeze) into a quantifiable metric in drug discovery, to help find better drugs for mechanical diseases. We screen 100,000s of drugs against numerous contractile human cell types to comprehensively map human mechanobiology (the "contractome") and identify promising drug development starting points to deliver novel medicines to treat mechanically-driven diseases including asthma, hypertension, preterm labor, fibrosis, and others.

Work that took human teams days to weeks closes in minutes. Cozmo is an operating system for the whole claim, end to end, and it runs on top of the estimating software, CRM and phone system already in place. Nothing gets ripped out and nothing gets migrated. This allows operators to run more jobs per adjuster and send estimates t

yc_shinkei-systems.tagline: Robots for longer-lasting, better-tasting fish at scale.
yc_shinkei-systems.description: 1.2B lbs of fish are caught everyday yet as little as 1 in 3 fish make it to a plate — most of this waste arises because fish are suffocated on boats or electrocuted on farms. Suffocation and inaccurate electrocution create stress and so acidify meat, damage quality and significantly reduce shelf-life. Artisanal techniques in high-end sushi multiply shelf-life and taste but, because of the variation in fish, are difficult to perform in a mechanical fashion. Shinkei automates traditional techniques using robotics to provide long-lasting and delicious fish for farmers and harvesters at scale.

yc_craniometrix.name: Craniometrix
yc_craniometrix.tagline: Using AI to help dementia patients age at home

We launched our care navigation service for dementia patients in July of 2025, hit $8M of ARR, and just raised a $15M Series A. We leverage AI to provide best-in-class care, alleviating the burden on providers. Come help us build!

yc_actipulse-neuroscience.name: Actipulse Neuroscience

yc_actipulse-neuroscience.description: Non-invasive brain stimulation is a widely-utilized, FDA cleared treatment used for patients diagnosed with depression, but is limited to a hospital setting due to the cost of the device, and complexity of treatment application. yc_momento.description: In Momento we are going through a challenging regulatory process to become a fully-licensed insurance carrier. We partner with therapeutics companies to screen their drugs, and we perform our own drug discovery for rare diseases that have no existing treatments. Our organoids are also fetal-like and enable discovery of novel drug targets for pediatric diseases. This technology was validated at Stanford, published in a prestigious journal, and has already led to the discovery of a drug target in a pediatric heart disease that could not have been found using traditional disease models.

Top prospects get the best calendar slots, matched to real availability. > Recover. No-shows and ghosted leads are automatically re-engaged. rift is built by growth engineers who ran inbound at high-velocity B2B companies and got tired of watch

yc_blyss.name: Blyss

Notebook can be used to increase the safety of DeFi, governance, and airdrops. This helps these teams move faster and cover design function on their own instead of contractors at early stages and when they start to scale their can produce a lot more design work, just like Midjourney.

yc_kontigo.name: Kontigo
yc_kontigo.description: We’re building Kontigo, a USDC Smart Neobank for Latinos in the U.S. and Latin America. yc_weel.name: Weel
yc_weel.description: Weel is the next-generation all-in-one driver co-pilot that redefines your driving experience by turning your smartphone into a complete safety and navigation hub. Our free app offers a built-in dashcam with easy video sharing, a smart navigation system, and advanced AI features—such as augmented reality navigation and ADAS—that reduce your risk by up to 30%. Say goodbye to expensive dashcams and complex setups – with Weel, you get complete driving safety and guidance in one free smartphone app.

yc_entropy.name: Entropy
yc_entropy.tagline: Autonomous intake and RCM for specialty clinics.

We're helping them see patients quicker, keep referrers in the loop, and get paid on time.

yc_bluedoor.name: Bluedoor

This has an Nvidia H100, which is 100x more powerful GPU than has ever been operated in space before. With this, they became the first entity to train an LLM in space and the first to run a version of Gemini in space. Starcloud will soon also run high-powered inference on C

yc_dataleap.name: Dataleap
yc_dataleap.description: At Dataleap we have one single focus - make knowledge work at your computer fun! Give all the other roles in sales, ops, hr the same super powers that engineers get with Cursor and Claude Code. Dataleap is the agentic operating system for the Enterprise. yc_handled.name: Handled
yc_handled.tagline: AI teammate for finance and operations teams at consumer brands
yc_handled.description: Consumer brands run finance and operations across ERPs, commerce platforms, 3PLs, accounting systems, email, and spreadsheets. Problems are often discovered only after they have cost the business time, margin, or revenue. Handled is an AI teammate for finance and operations. Handled answers questions about the business, proactively catches issues, and takes on recurri

yc_ionworks.name: Ionworks

yc_ionworks.description: Every battery company spends tens of millions of dollars a year on experiments. Simulations that replace experiments reduce these costs but are currently underutilized in industry because they are hard to create and run. We make simulations accessible to every engineer, by helping them to create models from their own data, then run large scale simulations in the cloud to explore the full design space.

yc_rescript.name: Rescript
yc_rescript.tagline: AI for Legal & Public Policy Teams
yc_rescript.description: Rescript is using AI to make the law transparent, accessible, and easy to act on. Laws and regulations differ across jurisdictions and are constantly changing, making them too complex for organizations to review and track manually at scale. We're building an agentic AI platform capable of aggregating and interpreting global regulations, tracking how they change, and identifying how organizations should respond. Our customers span AmLaw100 law firms, Fortune 100 corporations, and top trade associations across healthcare, retail, fintech and more. They depend on Rescript to help them comply with and act on an ever-changing regulatory landscape from the federal level down to individual cities.

yc_heroui.name: HeroUI

yc_heroui.description: HeroUI makes it simple for AI agents and developers to build beautiful, accessible, production-ready interfaces for web and mobile. yc_helium.name: Helium
yc_helium.description: Helium is building self-improving software — AI that continuously experiments on key moments in the user funnel to boost revenue. yc_haystackeditor.description: Haystack automatically learns real customer journeys from production traffic, figures out which ones a code change could affect, and replays them in isolated copies of production to catch regressions before they ship. When something breaks, Haystack shows exactly what changed across the UI, network calls, and events, then gives the failure back to your coding agent to fix and rerun. Teams get high-fidelity QA without having to write or maintain test cases.

yc_finosu.name: Finosu

yc_paasa.name: Paasa

Why? - Broken outward remittance process - Fear of making mistakes in tax or compliance - Paper-heavy onboarding processes of international brokers - Lack of trustworthy guidance Paasa offers a mobile app that enables Indians to trade worldwide, invest via advisory, and automate every cross-border tax filing.

yc_refactor.name: Refactor

yc_mineflow.description: Mineflow is an AI platform for mineral exploration. yc_piggy-robotics.name: Piggy Robotics
yc_piggy-robotics.tagline: Humanoid robots that do your chores for the price of an iPhone!
yc_piggy-robotics.description: We build humanoid robots that do your chores at iPhone prices. Humanoid companies today can only manufacture hundreds a year because motors are expensive and slow to assemble. We use artificial muscles. Each muscle is just a tube wrapped in braided fibre, and the whole robot is powered by a single pump — which means we can mass-produce humanoids by the millions. Our design is built for that scale from day one and is cheap enough to enter billions of homes.

Then once their 40 accounts are active and funded, finding the best price is a painstaking process involving third-party tools to search available offers. BeeBettor aggregates all these accounts into one app and automatically gives sports bettors the best price.

yc_stempad.name: Stempad
yc_stempad.description: You can think of Stempad as a Notion for science. It is the world's first true pen-and-paper alternative to fast scientific writing and collaborating. Stempad allows you to share your work, collaborate in real time, store your data, annotate, write papers, plan, takes notes, create presentations, and so much more. Our vision is to make it easier and faster for students and scientists to digitize and share their scientific ideas.

yc_rovr.name: Rovr

yc_nuntius.name: Nuntius

yc_altrina.name: Altrina

yc_baseline-ai.description: The main document in a clinical trial is the study protocol. yc_riskangle.name: RiskAngle
yc_riskangle.description: RiskAngle delivers fast, accurate summaries of unstructured medical records for insurance companies and law firms. Our AI-powered platform enables users to streamline underwriting, expedite claims processing, and prepare cases with confidence.

Before actions like approving a payment, changing admin permissions, exporting sensitive data, or letting an AI agent act on someone’s behalf, GrayPass returns allow, challenge, hold, or deny and produces signed proof tied to that action.

yc_frontrunner.name: Frontrunner

yc_ignition-benefits.name: Ignition Benefits

They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch. Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our agents chase suppliers, track equipment approvals and delivery dates, and flag delays so project teams can keep critical equipment moving without hunting for updates across emails and spreadsheets.

yc_boat.name: Boat
yc_boat.tagline: The best cloud VMs for billions of agents
yc_boat.description: **Problem** Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial. **Solution** Boat provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a sandbox, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing. **Why Boat and not any other cloud VM?** 1. It is ready out of the box: every sandbox ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker, snapshots, and templates, plus a CLI, SDK, API, and control pane for your fleet. 2. It is permissive and pa

yc_viraj-aero.name: Viraj Aero
yc_viraj-aero.tagline: Next generation engines for aircraft and data centers

yc_faraday.name: Faraday
yc_faraday.tagline: Industrial aOS between humans, agents, and robots

yc_agent-37.name: Agent 37
yc_agent-37.tagline: Persistent sandboxes for agents like hermes, openclaw, claude code
yc_agent-37.description: * Ready to Use Instantly: Skip the complex server setup. It comes pre loaded with top AI Agents (like Claude Code and Hermes) so your agents can start working immediately. * Keep Your Work Safe: Unlike other systems that delete everything when they finish a task, these sandboxes remember your files, code, and settings forever until you delete them. * Pay Only for What You Use: Stop paying for idle servers. You pay a tiny fee to store your files, but you only pay for compute power during the exact minutes your AI is actively running. * Zero Infrastructure Headaches: You don’t need to be a senior DevOps engineer or manage complex cloud networks. One simple command handles the entire backend fo

yc_kailash-labs.name: Kailash Labs
yc_kailash-labs.tagline: A factory for small and specialized video reasoning models
yc_kailash-labs.description: The world generates petabytes of video every day, and almost none of it is readable to machines. Frontier VLMs that can unlock this (like Gemini) are too expensive to run at the volume real industries have, too generic for any single task, and can't be deployed on-prem where sensitive video lives. We are building an auto vision factory: take video plus a customer's objective, distill a frontier model, and post-train a small open model that is SOTA on that one task and serve it blazingly fast. Our first product, Marlin, is a 2B-parameter open-weights video VLM that matches Gemini-2.5-flash on dense captioning and temporal grounding at a fraction of the cost.

yc_qokedas.name: Qokedas
yc_qokedas.description: Models are trained on the entire internet, but most of what happens on Earth is never written down. We turn those signals into training data so labs can make models better at science

yc_veeza-ai.name: Veeza AI
yc_veeza-ai.tagline: AI travel agent for people with weak passports, starting with visas.
yc_veeza-ai.description: Billions of people need tourist visas to travel the world. We use AI agents to prepare applications, verify documents, secure appointments, and handle the visa process end to end.

yc_simulithic.name: Simulithic
yc_simulithic.description: Simulithic continuously uses your production product like your real users do. We learn representative user journeys and run agents across different devices, browsers, account states, and environments to find failures that traditional automated tests miss. When something breaks, we reproduce it and alert engineering before they hear about it from a customer.

yc_sentient-os.name: Sentient OS
yc_sentient-os.tagline: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.
yc_sentient-os.description: Nobody's built truly proactive AI, because it requires running inference on your entire life. In the cloud, that's insanely expensive and a privacy nightmare. But not on your own chip. Every night, Sentient's on-device LLM wakes your Mac and understands what's new in your life (email, messages, files, Granola transcripts...), entirely locally, and distills it into a knowledge base. You wake up to your work already prepared: the reply you forgot, drafted from your own context; the subscription you never use renewing tomorrow, caught; the report you promised in the group chat, ready to send. Everything is one click from firing through computer use, and nothing fires until you click. Or click y

yc_herdr.name: herdr
yc_herdr.description: Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed. Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across every project — so you look only when an agent needs you. Every client is just a view: the bundled termina

yc_lambda-robotics.name: Lambda Robotics
yc_lambda-robotics.description: Lambda Robotics builds and deploys robots for the infrastructure powering frontier AI.

yc_opentag.name: OpenTag
yc_opentag.tagline: Model Agnostic AI coworker in Slack
yc_opentag.description: OpenTag is an AI coworker in your Slack with full context on your company. It answers questions and takes real work off your plate. It also keeps your wiki up to date automatically, so knowledge never goes stale.

yc_conifer.name: Conifer
yc_conifer.tagline: Least cost routing system to reduce 70%+ token spend
yc_conifer.description: There are thousands of models, providers, and harnesses, each with its own pricing and strengths, leaving an overwhelming number of choices when it comes to managing token spend and intelligence. Conifer uses intelligent routing and orchestration logic to handle the full path of each query: model selection, provider choice, and cache management. It all runs inside your existing harness, so tools like Claude Code and Codex work without changing your setup. By centralizing where inference occurs, Conifer lets companies save on their inference bill while leaving teams free to focus on what they are building.

yc_simantic.name: Simantic
yc_simantic.description: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.

yc_experiential-labs.name: Experiential Labs
yc_experiential-labs.tagline: Open source AI gateway that turns your traffic into better models
yc_experiential-labs.description: We are building an open source gateway for AI budget holders to control model access and turn their traffic into better models that they own. We're a team that has earned an ML PhD at Georgia Tech, scaled AutoGPT to 160k GitHub stars, and led a self-driving simulation team at Waabi.

yc_edviro.name: Edviro
yc_edviro.description: Edviro builds AI that operates energy infrastructure. We connect to meters, HVAC systems, batteries, solar, and other energy equipment and continuously handle the work required to keep them efficient: detecting and diagnosing problems to forecasting demand, simulating fixes, creating work orders, coordinating maintenance, and controlling equipment where authorized. Our energy world models learn how each site behaves, choose the highest-value actions, and verify the results against real operational, meter, and billing data.

yc_lightfield.name: Lightfield
yc_lightfield.tagline: AI that works for in-house legal teams
yc_lightfield.description: Lightfield connects to a company’s email, chat, and business systems and does the legal work before it reaches the legal team. It gathers context, applies company policies and past decisions, and presents the completed work to in-house counsel for approval.

yc_coarena.name: CoArena
yc_coarena.tagline: The biggest crowdsourced benchmark for Computer-Use
yc_coarena.description: CoArena is a live arena where anyone can use the world's top computer-use models racing two of them on the same real computer task and judging which one did it better. Every battle becomes something the AI labs can't build themselves, an honest test of their agents on real work, and the data to make them better.

yc_caution.name: Caution
yc_caution.tagline: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked
yc_caution.location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
yc_caution.description: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deploymen

yc_magma.name: Magma
yc_magma.description: We enable companies monetize their agents' traces.

yc_atomarine.name: Atomarine
yc_atomarine.tagline: Floating nuclear powered data centers at sea.
yc_atomarine.description: We are building nuclear power delivery ships to power our floating compute barges at sea. Our systems are fully standalone, have better cooling, and avoid all the resource competition that leads to local community opposition. Our centralized manufacturing allows us to deploy anywhere on Earth, four times faster than on land.

yc_billow-ai-labs.name: Billow AI Labs
yc_billow-ai-labs.tagline: AI-native Accounting Firm that's killing Deloitte
yc_billow-ai-labs.description: Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.

yc_hardware-intelligence.name: hardware intelligence
yc_hardware-intelligence.tagline: AI tools for the chips your AI runs on
yc_hardware-intelligence.description: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools that cut simulation and debugging time by an order of magnitude. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal - a waveform. We’ve developed WaveZip, which captures waveforms 500x smaller with 200x less overhead, and Wave, which beats frontier models on industry chip debugging benchmarks. We’re Rishov Sarkar (Georgia Tech Ph.D. in chip simulation) and Athreya Anand (ex-Google, M.S. ML/AI), YC S26. https://hardwareintelligence.ai

yc_osseus.name: Osseus
yc_osseus.tagline: The frontier data platform for health and biological AI
yc_osseus.description: In an era of cheap intelligence, the most important application of AI will be to improving human health, globally. Osseus provides off-the-shelf or custom medical and biological datasets and RL environments to frontier labs. We work with hospitals and clinics to provide our EHR and deploy AI models within clinical workflows, with models from both our frontier lab partners and our own research.

yc_allia-health.name: Allia Health
yc_allia-health.tagline: First AI-Native Medical Group for Mental Health
yc_allia-health.description: Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native clinical group for mental health. We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale - 600+ providers (350+ therapists, 200+ nurses & doctors, 30+ psychologists) across 70 sites in 32 states, plus telehealth nationwide. Every clinician runs on a single intelligent system of record. And, that intelligence coupled with scale unlocks what no single practice could achieve alone.

yc_salem-robotics-inc.name: Salem Robotics Inc
yc_salem-robotics-inc.tagline: Deploying robots to replace workers in hazardous spaces
yc_salem-robotics-inc.description: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we started in nuclear and are already expanding to other hazardous industries.

yc_robocurve.name: Robocurve
yc_robocurve.description: Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust. Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits. Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large perform

yc_hiloop.name: hiloop
yc_hiloop.tagline: Autoresearch as a service: we solve your hardest measurable problems
yc_hiloop.description: hiloop helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. hiloop runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud. We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization. Reach out to us for early access at founders@hiloop.ai.

yc_cuebench.name: CueBench
yc_cuebench.tagline: RL post-training for science reasoning and performance engineering

yc_dawn-industries.name: Dawn Industries
yc_dawn-industries.tagline: Automatic Diagnosis & Fix for Industrial Automation Cells
yc_dawn-industries.description: VIM connects to the entire cell: PLCs, robots, CNC machines, sensors. When a cell faults, VIM finds the cause, stages the fix, and the operator approves with one click. When a part drifts, VIM catches it seconds after the cut, inside the machine, and recommends the correction. Recovery drops from 30 minutes to under two, saving more than $15,000 per fault in large factories.

yc_nex.name: Nex
yc_nex.tagline: AI for high volume GTM Engineering
yc_nex.description: Nex builds and runs the complex, high-volume GTM workflows that general-purpose agents struggle with. Built by ex-HubSpotters who ran its three largest customer platforms and backed by HubSpot founder Dharmesh Shah.

yc_onecli.name: OneCLI
yc_onecli.tagline: The open source AI teammates for your company.
yc_onecli.description: OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source AI teammates platform for teams. Like Grok Bot, but self-hostable, loved by developers. Each employee gets their own sandboxed pro assistant agent, connected to their GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Dropbox, or CRM right from the chat/Slack, while the whole workspace runs under one policy your admins control. Agents never hold real secrets: the credential is injected at the network layer, per request, after the call is authorized. You can't steal what isn't there.

yc_vernius-systems-inc.name: Vernius Systems, Inc.
yc_vernius-systems-inc.description: We make mass-deployable radars for unmanned systems. Our first product is Archimedes, a radar seeker that finds and locks onto targets, enabling autonomous intercept on any drone. We have over $580M in LOIs for Archimedes, across some of the largest defense primes in Ukraine, the EU, and the Middle East. Seekers are the most critical and costly component in every autonomous interceptor. Developing a radar seeker takes a 200+ person team at Raytheon and hundreds of millions of dollars. Archimedes is 100x cheaper than existing radar seekers on the market - and is the first product to make it feasible to deploy radars on every drone.

yc_wondering.name: Wondering
yc_wondering.description: Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go. It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights. Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download

yc_tracer.name: Tracer
yc_tracer.tagline: Combining open-source AI models for better answers at lower cost
yc_tracer.description: Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model. Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.

yc_avoca-systems.name: Avoca Systems
yc_avoca-systems.tagline: The AI operating system for radiology networks
yc_avoca-systems.description: Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.

yc_subvysion.name: SubVysion
yc_subvysion.tagline: Autonomous rovers to make the ‘Google Maps’ of underground utilities
yc_subvysion.description: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.

yc_ethos-space-resources.name: Ethos Space Resources
yc_ethos-space-resources.tagline: We make silicon on the Moon, to power everything in space.
yc_ethos-space-resources.description: Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.

yc_spaceflow-technologies-inc.name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
yc_spaceflow-technologies-inc.tagline: AI-native procurement services for the physical economy
yc_spaceflow-technologies-inc.description: SpaceFlow is an AI-native procurement services company for businesses that make, move and serve physical goods. We help procurement teams bring more spend under management, execute source-to-contract work and turn identified savings into realized savings without adding headcount or replacing existing systems.

yc_petrarch.name: Petrarch
yc_petrarch.tagline: Internal industrial company data for frontier labs
yc_petrarch.description: Petrarch brings internal company data to frontier labs, starting with manufacturing and industrial companies. We source data including codebases, project files, and payments from bankruptcy courts, then de-identify and prepare the data for model training.

yc_locke.name: Locke
yc_locke.description: Locke builds AI agents that help companies and governments work together. Our agents power Locke Government Affairs, the first AI-native government affairs firm, and are being deployed to government agencies across America. Every consequential American company in the 21st century will need to work with the government: AI labs, data centers, healthcare, defense, robotics, the list goes on. Locke is building the AI infrastructure to power the next era of public-private collaboration. Locke's team comes from The White House, Deloitte, the US Congress, and the Pentagon.

yc_florin.name: Florin
yc_florin.tagline: Florin is an AI-native insurance company that runs autonomously
yc_florin.description: Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terrafirma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.

yc_earendil-robotics.name: Earendil Robotics
yc_earendil-robotics.tagline: Drone swarm defence at a small-unit level
yc_earendil-robotics.description: Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems. Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments. Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.

yc_hebbian-robotics.name: Hebbian Robotics
yc_hebbian-robotics.tagline: APIs for robotics data teams to verify data quality for model training
yc_hebbian-robotics.description: Hebbian Robotics builds APIs for robotics data teams to verify data quality for model training. Our customers use us to build quality control pipelines in just a few lines of code, with custom models 10x faster and 8x cheaper than general foundation models. https://hebbianrobotics.com/ https://github.com/Hebbian-Robotics/hflow

yc_princeps.name: PRINCEPS
yc_princeps.tagline: AI-native insurance company for the compute economy
yc_princeps.description: PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.

yc_hop-aero.name: Hop Aero
yc_hop-aero.tagline: Rocket cargo delivery to contested environments
yc_hop-aero.description: Hop Aero is building rocket cargo vehicles that deliver to contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes. Our rockets fly point-to-point into the most austere locations at hypersonic speeds. Hop Aero's goal is to provide the U.S. and allies the asymmetric advantage that deters a future major conflict.

yc_agent-fm.name: Agent FM
yc_agent-fm.tagline: One group chat to hear and steer your coding agents.
yc_agent-fm.description: Agent FM is a desktop app that gives engineers one group chat to hear and steer their coding agents. Instead of manually bouncing between different claude code and codex sessions, and combing through walls of text to monitor agents, engineers just tune in to Agent FM. Agents share important progress updates, blockers, assumptions, and decisions in the group chat. Engineers get live text and audio updates and respond right from the chat.

yc_dock.name: Dock
yc_dock.tagline: Multiplayer workspace for agents and humans
yc_dock.description: Dock is a multiplayer agent workspace where you spin up teams of specialized, proactive agents that can do the work of entire departments. They communicate, unblock each other, and manage each other to get work done, so you're not the bottleneck babysitting a dozen chat windows.

yc_verdict-machine.name: Verdict Machine
yc_verdict-machine.tagline: AI cybersecurity for financial institutions' digital assets
yc_verdict-machine.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
yc_verdict-machine.description: Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies. In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks. The founding team launched and led

yc_tovenai.name: TovenAI
yc_tovenai.tagline: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms
yc_tovenai.description: TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage. With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.

yc_hyperprobe.name: HyperProbe
yc_hyperprobe.tagline: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime
yc_hyperprobe.description: With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data. HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs. Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability la

yc_grip.name: Grip
yc_grip.description: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipul

yc_skymerse.name: Skymerse
yc_skymerse.description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.

yc_hubble-ai.name: Hubble
yc_hubble-ai.tagline: AI-native retrieval engine for medical records
yc_hubble-ai.description: Hubble is the AI-native retrieval engine for medical records, delivered in one API. I scaled Grow Therapy to a $3B valuation; my cofounder built One Medical's first AI agents, now used by millions of patients. Four weeks in, we already have ten signed customers and 7-figure year-one revenue across platform and usage fees. Every new agentic use case across industries like legal, clinical trials, consumer health, insurance, needs a complete medical record, and today that still means faxes and phone calls. Hubble fixes that with voice and browser agents that reach the providers APIs can't, in a market worth $45B just in the verticals we've mapped so far.

yc_palisade-2.name: Palisade
yc_palisade-2.tagline: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets

yc_83-sciences.name: 83 Sciences
yc_83-sciences.tagline: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data
yc_83-sciences.description: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.

yc_chromie.name: Chromie
yc_chromie.tagline: We help startups win gov contracts
yc_chromie.description: The intelligent operating system for government contracting. Built by former AI engineers and government officials.

yc_lamb-labs.name: Lamb Labs
yc_lamb-labs.tagline: Lightning fast chips with hardcoded AI models
yc_lamb-labs.description: Lamb Labs is building MPUs (Model Processing Units), custom chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into the chip. Unlike GPUs, which move weights between memory and compute, MPUs keep the model on-chip, targeting up to 20,000+ tok/s and a 63× higher intelligence per watt.

yc_shiraz-ai.name: Shiraz AI
yc_shiraz-ai.tagline: Robots that learn on the job
yc_shiraz-ai.description: We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over. Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

yc_mireye.name: Mireye
yc_mireye.tagline: Search Engine for the Physical World
yc_mireye.description: AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex. Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools. Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

yc_touchy.name: Touchy
yc_touchy.tagline: AI iOS assistant that instantly uses voice and video to take action
yc_touchy.description: Touchy is your personal AI assistant that lives on your iPhone. One button press and you're talking to an assistant that sees what you see, remembers what you tell it, and takes action across 1,000+ apps--so you can get back to living in the moment.

yc_derya.name: Derya
yc_derya.description: Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods. Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.

yc_pennant.name: Pennant
yc_pennant.tagline: The World Model for Corporate Governance
yc_pennant.description: Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.

yc_decawork.name: Decawork
yc_decawork.tagline: Training company-specific models that approve AI actions.
yc_decawork.description: An agent’s access should depend on the task it is doing. The same action can be appropriate for one task and wrong for another. Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step. We train small, company-specific models that approve AI actions in real time. They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed. Access is specific to the task at hand and reassessed as the agent works. Companies will rent intelligence from AI labs or run open-source models to power their

yc_carsignal.name: CarSignal
yc_carsignal.tagline: The AI Operating System for Auto Shops.
yc_carsignal.description: CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops. Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting. CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause. The same system carries each job from booking and intake through inspections, estimates, parts, approvals, payment, and follow-up, so technicians spend less time searchin

yc_axelrod.name: Axelrod
yc_axelrod.description: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded and Marriott hotels and is live across 3 continents.

yc_levocred-ai.name: Levocred AI
yc_levocred-ai.description: Levocred AI is the Bloomberg of loans: AI agents that run and price a lender's book.
