One fund cut the time to mark its book from a week to two hours and now names us as data agent, the system of record, in its loan purchase agreements. $22T of US loans never trade because nobody can price them efficiently and defensibly. We fix pricing first by deploying inside lenders. Trading follows, the way it did for bonds.

yc_praxis-robotics.name: Praxis Robotics
yc_praxis-robotics.tagline: Turns real businesses into robotics data vendors
yc_praxis-robotics.description: Praxis captures the data physical AI is bottlenecked on: egocentric video, 3D scans, and multimodal capture from inside real industrial and residential environments. Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.

yc_care-gp.name: Care GP
yc_care-gp.tagline: AI agents to run primary healthcare operations
yc_care-gp.description: Care GP is building AI agents to run operations for primary healthcare clinics

yc_radley.name: Radley
yc_radley.description: Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up. Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year. From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end. We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expande

yc_agnost-ai.name: Agnost AI
yc_agnost-ai.tagline: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them.
yc_agnost-ai.description: Agnost AI reads every conversation a company's AI Agent has with its users to find where it's silently failing and then turns that same data into custom models that run the agent better, faster & cheaper than frontier models.

yc_agentcard.name: Agentcard
yc_agentcard.description: Agentcard.sh is a debit card for AI agents. Agents can use Agentcard’s API to issue cards and pay for things online autonomously.

yc_provenmetal.name: ProvenMetal
yc_provenmetal.tagline: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
yc_provenmetal.description: ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.

yc_gamgee.name: Gamgee
yc_gamgee.description: ​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We m

yc_inkbox.name: Inkbox
yc_inkbox.tagline: The identity and communication layer for AI agents
yc_inkbox.description: For your AI agents to behave like teammates, we give them persistent identities with their own email, phone, and iMessage. We also provide them an agent-to-agent channel, so they can communicate for task delegation.

yc_cosmic-robotics.name: Cosmic Robotics
yc_cosmic-robotics.tagline: Autonomous construction on Earth and beyond
yc_cosmic-robotics.description: Our mission is to build a city on Mars. Cosmic-1, the first equipment in our fleet, is an autonomous robot capable of heavy-lift manipulation. Its been deployed on some of the largest solar farms in the US, more than doubling labor productivity across tens of thousands of panel installs. We're scaling in solar, expanding in data centers, and building lunar construction robotics under contract with NASA.

yc_markov.name: Markov
yc_markov.tagline: Expert computer-use data for frontier AI labs
yc_markov.description: Markov builds expert computer-use datasets for frontier AI labs. Our datasets include screen recordings + mouse/keyboard actions of professionals using CAD, design and enterprise software. We work with the top AI labs and we’ve gotten more than 350k downloads on HuggingFace. Our long-term goal is to be the full stack platform for computer-use AI, starting with data and then the infrastructure to train and deploy computer-use models. Dev and Harish are technical co-founders. Dev studied aerospace engineering at IIT Madras and was the youngest team member at Sarvam - India’s top AI lab. Harish is an Emergent Ventures grantee and his prior robotics work was featured in top national publications

yc_familiar.name: Familiar
yc_familiar.tagline: Movies in Every Language. Better than Humans.
yc_familiar.description: Familiar is the Neolab for world translation. Dubbing into 30 languages. Now with Familiar, the same actor's performance is preserved instead of a mismatched voice over a mismatched face. One model does the voice, the lips, and the scene together, with identity permanence and scene & world understanding. Built by the researchers who pioneered joint audio-visual human models.

yc_lumeria.name: Lumeria
yc_lumeria.description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.

yc_marengo.name: Marengo
yc_marengo.tagline: AI-Native Engineering Firm designing Data Centers
yc_marengo.description: Marengo is an AI-native engineering firm designing data centers in half the time and half the cost. We have $4M in design partnerships with two of the world's largest developers ($XB). Marengo is backed by YC, Exor, Future Planet Capital, undisclosed $2B AUM family office, and other top-tier investors. Our team includes the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.

yc_ronanrx-inc.name: RonanRx Inc.
yc_ronanrx-inc.tagline: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
yc_ronanrx-inc.description: RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s. In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week. We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive. What makes this possible is AI. Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose. Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platfo

yc_waybill.name: Waybill
yc_waybill.tagline: Agentic procurement & inventory for deep tech teams.
yc_waybill.description: Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf. Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated. Take your supply chain for granted. Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).

yc_executor.name: Executor
yc_executor.description: Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client. We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to. If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.

yc_last-accounting-company.name: Last Accounting Company
yc_last-accounting-company.description: Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin. LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.

yc_pacific.name: Pacific
yc_pacific.tagline: Mass-producing and financing micro data center incredibly quickly.
yc_pacific.description: We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week. Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue. Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. We'll use the same mecha

yc_luca-iq.name: Luca IQ
yc_luca-iq.tagline: API-first tax engine for CPA firms and developers
yc_luca-iq.description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.

yc_financial-datasets.name: Financial Datasets
yc_financial-datasets.tagline: Connect your agents to the stock market
yc_financial-datasets.description: Financial Datasets is an applied AI research lab building search and data infrastructure for agents, starting with financial markets. We turn filings, company disclosures, and market data into structured, searchable information - helping agents find relevant facts, answer financial questions, and monitor markets in real time. For 40 years, market data was built for people reading screens. We're rebuilding it for agents that research every company, all day, across the world.

yc_trynearby.name: TryNearby
yc_trynearby.description: TryNearby connects local businesses with creators who live nearby. Restaurants subscribe monthly and automatically get booked visits from local creators who film, edit, and post a review to the local algorithm. This creates a steady stream of content that compounds into discovery on TikTok, Instagram, and increasingly AI search. Over 100 restaurants and thousands of creators are on the platform across Southern California, with AI agents handling matching, booking, and every creator conversation.

yc_denta.name: Denta
yc_denta.description: Denta is a full-stack insurance carrier rewriting healthcare. Starting with dental insurance, we are relentlessly simplifying the process for patients to receive better coverage at a lower cost.

yc_isengard-industries-inc.name: Isengard Industries Inc
yc_isengard-industries-inc.tagline: Mass-produced AI strike systems and Counter-UAS
yc_isengard-industries-inc.description: Isengard Industries is not another drone company. We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge. We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age. More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.

yc_ekho-labs.name: Ekho Labs
yc_ekho-labs.description: Ekho predicts the wars, strikes and tariffs that break global shipping, and tells freight teams which shipments are exposed and what to do about them. Predicting escalation is what our team did for eight years before this - now we bring the same engine to logistics.

yc_moving-atoms.name: Moving Atoms
yc_moving-atoms.description: Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics. It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it. This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive. In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.

yc_vestris.name: Vestris
yc_vestris.tagline: AI native platform for real estate closings
yc_vestris.description: Vestris automates title processing end-to-end, from contract to close, so title shops can close more deals with fewer processors. Title insurance has famously high margins, but slow, manual processing is a constant pain — especially in today's bleeding housing market.

yc_ultrasonium.name: Ultrasonium
yc_ultrasonium.tagline: Metal manufacturing, faster, cheaper, and more versatile.
yc_ultrasonium.description: The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous. Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demandi

yc_arbital.name: Arbital
yc_arbital.tagline: The social trading app for stocks, memes, and perps
yc_arbital.description: Arbital lets you trade perps, memes, stocks, and run market-making strategies from one place. In our first 7 months, 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B in volume through Arbital, and we're now doing $435M/month. We're building towards a social, mobile-first trading app that brings tokenized equities, crypto, and perps to everyone.

yc_pokerclubhub.name: PokerClubHub
yc_pokerclubhub.tagline: Host a Poker Club and Make Money
yc_pokerclubhub.description: TL;DR: PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money. Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs. Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players can get scammed and withdrawing takes ages. This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake w

yc_neuron-industries.name: Neuron Industries
yc_neuron-industries.description: Neuron is crafting the world’s first purpose-built industrial controller for AI, replacing the antiquated PLCs running every machine and factory. We help customers from chemical processing to nuclear reactors compress controls projects from weeks to hours.

yc_neuromorphic.name: Neuromorphic
yc_neuromorphic.description: We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!

yc_lato.name: LATO
yc_lato.description: The best investments come from conviction, and conviction comes from understanding a market deeply: its customers, its competitors, and where it's heading. Today that understanding is slow and expensive to build. Reaching the right people takes weeks, a commercial study costs $300k+, and each one starts from scratch. LATO does this research end-to-end, combining public data and the fund's own knowledge with first-hand interviews of a market's consumers, experts, and operators. This research grounds a simulation of the market to predict how market participants behave.

yc_risklytics.name: Risklytics
yc_risklytics.description: Risklytics is the insurance company for frontier tech such as physical AI, robotics, and data centers. Companies answer 6 questions and we bind a tailored policy that other insurance companies won’t.

yc_daqstra.name: Daqstra
yc_daqstra.tagline: AI-native test infrastructure layer for hardware companies
yc_daqstra.description: Daqstra is the AI-native orchestration layer for physical R&D. It saves engineers in Aerospace, Energy and Robotics hundreds of man hours managing test infrastructure by connecting fragmented test hardware, bringing live and historical test data into one place, and by giving engineers an API to orchestrate their entire test setup. We enable teams to spend less time rebuilding test infrastructure and more time improving the hardware they test.

yc_tenor.name: Tenor
yc_tenor.tagline: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native service businesses.
yc_tenor.description: Tenor enables domain experts to build, run, and scale AI-native service businesses. The next generation of successful white-collar service businesses will be built and scaled around AI from the ground up. These companies need more than capable AI models. They need a company data layer, governed workflows that AI can execute, and harnesses that continuously improve based on outcomes and decision checkpoints. Tenor is building this infrastructure so millions of AI-native businesses don’t have to build it themselves.

yc_qlo.name: Qlo
yc_qlo.description: Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter. We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.

yc_fabraix.name: Fabraix
yc_fabraix.tagline: The world's frontier hacker of AI agents.
yc_fabraix.description: Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol. AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI a

yc_omanta.name: Omanta
yc_omanta.description: Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis. We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions. For clinicians, we act as a collaborative partner, providing a living roadmap for ongoing patient care built on a rigorous and evolving scientific evidence base. We fully operationalize patient-specific research programs, covering tissue logistics, diagnostic follow-up, data int

yc_rational.name: Rational
yc_rational.description: Rational is building the first accounting firm with no humans. It's entirely run by our AI employees, who go from client intake to doing the books to filing with the IRS. We secure 90% cost reduction, 24/7 support, and an overall seamless experience for businesses.

yc_aktoria-robotics.name: Aktoria Robotics
yc_aktoria-robotics.description: Operate any robot, anywhere in the world.

yc_vendo.name: Vendo
yc_vendo.tagline: Let your users build their own features on top of your product
yc_vendo.description: Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code. Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take a

yc_click.name: Click
yc_click.tagline: Research services for ChatGPT and Claude
yc_click.description: Click builds useful services that meet users right inside ChatGPT and Claude. We're starting with a research service that provides external context that the built-in web search misses - like data from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. It makes research on people & companies even deeper with specialized, source-backed context beyond built-in web search, while enabling new tasks like comparing live flight fares right inside the chat.

yc_whitespace.name: Whitespace
yc_whitespace.tagline: AI Operating System for Wholesale Distribution
yc_whitespace.description: Whitespace builds AI agents that run the entire operation of supply chain businesses, starting with wholesale distributors. We give them self-improving AI agents that learn their business and do work like inventory planning and customer service. We're building towards a world where all supply chain operations run through our agents, and all physical goods purchases can happen across businesses without human touch.

yc_almanac.name: Almanac
yc_almanac.description: Almanac is an AI agent that deeply understands your work. Today people rely on a stack of productivity tools to hold the context of their work including todo lists, issue trackers, wikis, and CRMs. All of them have to be updated by hand, and none were built for AI. Almanac maintains its own self-updating productivity suite for you. This gives it an absurdly good understanding of your work, based on which it proactively gets things done for you. Almanac starts with individuals, but it's built for teams. As more of a team connects their work, the agent gains shared context across everyone, so it understands not just what you're doing but how the whole team's work fits together.

yc_tarebio.name: TareBio
yc_tarebio.tagline: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks.
yc_tarebio.description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.

yc_greypoint-industries.name: Greypoint Industries
yc_greypoint-industries.tagline: Building drone swarms that hunt hidden enemies.
yc_greypoint-industries.description: We build LEGION, a drone swarm that identifies, geolocates, and tracks every emitter on the battlefield using the enemy’s own radio signals. LEGION enables our warfighters to precisely track previously obscured targets like jammers, command posts, and drone operators so they can proactively respond to threats instead of reacting to them.

yc_hilstart.name: Hilstart
yc_hilstart.description: We build physical agent harnesses to enable AI to debug, validate, and ship functional hardware and software.

yc_aerogen-systems.name: Aerogen Systems
yc_aerogen-systems.description: We are building the future of chip manufacturing. Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible. We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible? Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airb

yc_graphify-labs.name: Graphify Labs
yc_graphify-labs.tagline: On-device Knowledge Graph engine for Enterprise Software
yc_graphify-labs.description: Graphify is a Knowledge Graph control plane for enterprise software. The open-source tool has 116K+ GitHub stars and 6.5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Shopify, Datadog, JP Morgan, American Express, Harvey, Automation Anywhere, and Vanguard. On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess. The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context

yc_ooak-data.name: Ooak Data
yc_ooak-data.tagline: We turn company data into training data
yc_ooak-data.description: Ooak Data turns internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be tested on real work.

yc_noril1.name: Nori
yc_noril1.tagline: The most capable American-made humanoid robot for $1,688
yc_noril1.description: We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business. Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter. Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have over $440k+ in sales. We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it befor

yc_bloomy.name: Bloomy
yc_bloomy.description: Bloomy is the best way to teach anything in school. We provide schools with an AI-native academic system comprising core and supplemental curriculum, AI teaching, and assessment to help K-12 students learn faster. Backed by the founders of Clever.

yc_machine0.name: machine0
yc_machine0.description: machine0 is a CLI for agent compute: `machine0 new mybox` gives your agent a full cloud VM, billed by the minute, from small up to 60 vCPU / 240 GB and 8×H100s. Agents drive it themselves via CLI or MCP. Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent working on a hard feature runs 6-8 hours. Auto-research agents run for days. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.

yc_talentpluto.name: Pluto
yc_talentpluto.description: Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them filterable. Pluto makes them searchable. Professionals spend 10 minutes talking to Pluto's voice agent about what they've done, what they're great at, and what they want next. Pluto turns that into a structured picture of who someone actually is, capturing the competency and intent that resumes and LinkedIn don't. When companies and AI agents go looking to hire, Pluto makes the right people discoverable. 27K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto, and 50+ companies, including Mercor, Warp, and Rho, use it to find and reach the right people. Long-term, we're building the LinkedIn for agents.

yc_flowmanual.name: FlowManual
yc_flowmanual.description: FlowManual is the all-in-one AI estimating, bidding, and purchasing platform for both general and MEP construction contractors. Built by two engineers and Harvard dropouts, FlowManual automates the buying process during pre-construction. With FlowManual, specialty contractors win more work while general contractors deliver at higher standards.

yc_elite.name: Elite
yc_elite.description: Elite builds AI voice agents that run the front office for healthcare practices. Elite answers every patient call instantly and finishes the job inside the practice's EHR: scheduling, triage, referrals, refills, eligibility, intake, and billing, across voice, SMS, and web, around the clock. Front offices are drowning in phone volume, so patients wait on hold, calls go unanswered, and staff get pulled away from care. Elite picks up every call, resolves the routine ones end to end, and escalates anything complex to the team with full context. It ships knowing the scheduling protocols of 18 specialties and writes back to more than 19 EHRs including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and ModMed

yc_peer.name: Peer
yc_peer.description: Peer is building an AI-native freight brokerage that quotes freight, finds the right trucking companies, tracks shipments, and handles problems from pickup through delivery for shippers.

yc_molagri.name: Molagri
yc_molagri.description: Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture. We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use. Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.

yc_cerenovus.name: Cerenovus
yc_cerenovus.tagline: AI that finds value creation opportunities across enterprise…
yc_cerenovus.description: We are building an AI operating partner that reads every record a company produces to find and prioritize value creation opportunities, including costly operational inefficiencies no one is tracking. Cerenovus warns leaders before small problems become expensive and turns weeks of manual investigation into evidence-backed answers in minutes. Every claim links to its source, and every finding is ranked by impact. Companies use it to improve their operations; private equity and advisory firms deploy it across the businesses they own or advise.

yc_agency-tool-company.name: Agency Tool Company
yc_agency-tool-company.tagline: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.
yc_agency-tool-company.description: Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics. Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets. Jack Morrison and

yc_standard-machines.name: Standard Machines
yc_standard-machines.description: We build environments and evaluations to train and evaluate models on advanced chip design.

yc_edotenv.name: EdotEnv
yc_edotenv.tagline: Quant Neolab building self-improving agents from quant data
yc_edotenv.description: A Quant Neolab building toward RSI by leveraging markets as self-improving research environments. They work with frontier AI labs and academic groups building research harnesses, evaluation benchmarks, and post-training environments.

yc_traceforce.name: Traceforce
yc_traceforce.description: AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up. Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.

yc_veltha.name: Veltha
yc_veltha.tagline: AI native TPA starting with workers comp
yc_veltha.description: Veltha is the AI native TPA starting with workers comp. We handle claim for insurance providers end to end. Learn more at https://veltha.ai

yc_tarifflo-inc.name: Tarifflo Inc.
yc_tarifflo-inc.tagline: Supply chain compliance and cost savings
yc_tarifflo-inc.description: Tarifflo is the infrastructure layer for modern customs - AI-powered filing, tariff recovery, and customs intelligence on one platform. Filing should be free. Legacy ABI software charges you per entry, per user, per module. Brokers charge for every transaction. Tarifflo's filing software costs nothing - file directly with CBP under companies own filer codes. We make money when our clients do. 1 in 8 entries has an error that overpays duty - misclassification, tariff stacking, valuation, origin. Most importers never catch them. Our AI audits your entries, finds the overpayments, and helps file for your refund. Under both is the same engine, live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Ch

yc_callbook-ai.name: Callbook AI
yc_callbook-ai.tagline: AI collections agency for late stage portfolios
yc_callbook-ai.description: Callbook AI is a collections agency operated by AI. We collect late stage portfolios by finding, contacting and negotiating with borrowers.

yc_definite.name: Definite
yc_definite.tagline: Build everyday back-office agents on one live model of your books
yc_definite.description: Definite is where finance teams build everyday back-office agents on one live model of their books. We plug into your ERP, ledger, payroll, and payments read-only and compile everything into one clean model that stays current as money moves. Your back-office team then builds agents on top in plain English. We never write back and we never move money. The agents are yours, the plumbing is ours. We met in first year computer science at Waterloo and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo. At Optiver they ran an n8n hackathon and the interns automated basically nothing. It couldn't talk to the systems that mattered. When we pitched banks and fintechs on agents, they kept telling us the same thing.

yc_alkera-ai.name: Alkera AI
yc_alkera-ai.tagline: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents
yc_alkera-ai.description: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.

yc_rasyn.name: Rasyn
yc_rasyn.description: We builds foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design ne

yc_manifold-2.name: Manifold
yc_manifold-2.tagline: Drop-in robotic labor that works on Day 1
yc_manifold-2.description: The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.

yc_screenpipe.name: screenpipe
yc_screenpipe.tagline: Turn your company's computer work into AI agents.
yc_screenpipe.description: Screenpipe records and learns how people in your company work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Model agnostic and data is stored on your device and/or where your team choose, source available.

yc_spectre-intelligence.name: Spectre Intelligence
yc_spectre-intelligence.tagline: We are a multi-strategy trading firm that trains AI traders.
yc_spectre-intelligence.description: Spectre Intelligence is a neotrading firm. We create AI traders instead of hiring human ones. Currently trading semis + bio.

yc_zaplar.name: Zaplar
yc_zaplar.description: Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels. Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously. Learn more at https://zaplar.com

yc_prodigy-research.name: Prodigy Research
yc_prodigy-research.tagline: Training the world's best AI model for quantitative finance.
yc_prodigy-research.description: Prodigy is the frontier AI trading research lab. We've trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We've already achieved more than 100% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, doubling our capital while major indices were flat. Our founders previously worked on a trading desk at Jane Street, trained frontier AI models at Google DeepMind and shipped cutting-edge AI at Apple to billions of customers. Join us as we use AI to solve the market.

yc_touchmark.name: Touchmark
yc_touchmark.description: Buy tokens over a time window from the provider of your choice at a price fixed today - 10-30% off the on-demand price. If your plans change - resell your reserved capacity to another buyer.

yc_exosat.name: Exosat
yc_exosat.tagline: Building a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink
yc_exosat.description: Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By designing our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from other nations to bypass capacity bottlenecks and access equatorial orbits. We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet. We've already signed hundreds of millio

yc_codag.name: Codag
yc_codag.tagline: The AI gateway for cheaper, faster, permissioned agents.
yc_codag.description: Codag compresses tool call outputs before agents read them, which reduces token spend by 20-30% while retaining output accuracy. Govern and see analytics on agent dollars across all model providers and internal agents.

yc_contextdev.name: Context.dev
yc_contextdev.tagline: We give AI agents realtime web context via API
yc_contextdev.description: Context.dev gives AI agents structured data from any website through a single API. We help developers build smarter agents & products that depend on accurate, fresh web data. If you need structured data from the internet, you need Context.dev Proud to power agentic products at Mintlify, Super, Vizzy, Klarna, and 600+ other companies.

yc_glen.name: Glen
yc_glen.tagline: Institutional Learning Layer for Every Agent in Your Company
yc_glen.description: Glen is the layer that unifies every agent your company runs. Glen pulls in agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus Slack messages, GitHub prs, tickets, docs and calls. When a new agent picks up a task, Glen finds relevant prior context and injects it in the agents context window to steer it, producing knowledge work that is significantly higher quality, faster and cheaper. Glen does more. You can query the original agent behind any line of code, or search every session your org has ever run. It distills what your team does into skills and surfaces the right one automatically. Agents work multiplayer, picking up the style and context of whoever else is on the file. Transcript

yc_stoa.name: Stoa
yc_stoa.description: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.

yc_joinmarble.name: Marble
yc_joinmarble.description: Marble is the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house. Restaurants, cafes and bars still run on a patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets, clipboards and tribal knowledge, which costs the industry billions each year in stockouts, food waste, and lost profit. Marble replaces that entire stack with one system. Computer vision and voice AI capture real-time inventory levels 90% faster than manual counts, ML models forecast item-level demand at 97% accuracy, and AI agents run dozens of end-to-end workflows autonomously, from procurement and invoice reconciliation to scheduling, food prep, menu engineering, and more.

yc_grocalo.name: Grocalo
yc_grocalo.tagline: AI brain for creators that runs their social content
yc_grocalo.description: Grocalo (S26) is an AI brain that runs content for creators. We understand their audiences, using video understanding and deep platform analytics to bottle up the taste behind each creator and personalize and distribute content to creator specific audiences. Grocalo generated 2B views and gained 4M followers for our creators in the last 2 months. Some of our clients include Jimmy O. Yang (Comedian, 11M followers), King Bach (72M followers), Leenda Dong (28M followers), Steven He (30M followers), Sheena Melwani (18M followers), and Jeannie Mai (TV host, 6M followers). Content should be personalized and data-driven. We’ve developed the most advanced AI brain replicating viral content for any g

yc_ai-coach.name: COACH
yc_ai-coach.tagline: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.
yc_ai-coach.description: 85% of all sales still happen face-to-face. Coach is how those get closed. Our AI turns in-depth sales conversation analysis into company knowledge and personalized coaching to help reps close more deals.

yc_deepreach-inc.name: DeepReach Inc.
yc_deepreach-inc.tagline: Network for Physical AI Data Business
yc_deepreach-inc.description: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the software platform, t

yc_mochi.name: Mochi
yc_mochi.description: Mochi is an app to watch and create anime microdramas: fast paced shows with a cliffhanger every minute. We produce originals with AI, collaborating with writers from Marvel, Cartoon Network, and Toei Animation, and our users can also create in app too - with over 500 episodes created each day from 3,000+ creators.

yc_alloovium.name: Alloovium
yc_alloovium.tagline: The company brain for construction companies
yc_alloovium.description: Alloovium is the document intelligence layer for construction 🏗️ It reads every document and piece of data on a project (contracts, specs, drawings, compliance records, conversations), turning them into answers you can trust and actions with real value: every answer cites its exact source sentence, paperwork is checked clause by clause against the builder's own Integrated Management System, and nothing AI-drafted moves without a human sign-off, with it all compliant by default.

yc_dialogus.name: Dialogus
yc_dialogus.description: Dialogus builds self-improving AI voice agents for enterprise operations. Our agents handle high-volume workflows across customer support, sales, collections, and other operational functions, integrating directly with the systems enterprises already use. Our agents continuously learn from real conversations and business outcomes: identifying where interactions fail, proposing improvements, testing those changes across thousands of simulated conversations, and deploying better versions with human oversight. The result is AI that doesn’t just automate calls, it gets better at doing the job over time.

yc_mosaic-inc.name: Mosaic
yc_mosaic-inc.tagline: Defining the frontier of multiplayer AI.
yc_mosaic-inc.description: Mosaic gives teams and their coding agents shared memory across every session, so everyone can understand what happened, why decisions were made, and pick up where someone else left off. We started as a real-time coding environment where multiple people and their agents can work together live. It went viral, defined the multiplayer AI category, and inspired frontier labs like Anthropic. Together, we’re building the infrastructure for people and agents to share context and work together.

yc_bizmark.name: Bizmark
yc_bizmark.description: Hey YC! We're Bizmark. I (Rodrigo) grew up in a factory, watching my mum run everything through Excel and email. That’s why we’ve built Otto, the OpenClaw for manufacturers. In a few days, he learns from your systems and spreadsheets to take over repetitive work in procurement, quoting, and production planning. Otto is live at multiple factories, bringing in $108k in annual recurring revenue. Last month, he worked the equivalent of 9 full-time employees. I did CS at UChicago and built a distribution business from 0 to $60M. My cousin and cofounder Oscar did CS at Stanford and deployed AI for the US Air Force, Amazon, and the factories of Johnson & Johnson and Intel. There's a quarter of a mi

yc_riften.name: Riften
yc_riften.description: Intelligence will be the most valuable asset a company owns. Today, almost every company rents it. Companies pay a handful of labs one token at a time. Each dollar buys an answer, not an asset. They spend more, but own nothing more. Riften reverses that. Change one environment variable and Riften becomes the gateway for a company's AI traffic. We route each request to the lowest-cost model that can do the job, serving most work on open-weight models we host. Customers save money immediately without rebuilding their products. The gateway is the entry point. Over time, Riften turns the company's work into private models built on open weights and shaped around the business. What begins as cheap

yc_buildbox.name: Buildbox
yc_buildbox.tagline: Agent analytics for real user outcomes
yc_buildbox.description: Buildbox helps product teams improve the human-agent experience. We analyze user intent, agent behavior, and outcomes to find where users get stuck or lose trust, then turn those findings into ranked, reproducible issues.

yc_realpact.name: RealPact
yc_realpact.tagline: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
yc_realpact.description: RealPact builds AI agents that handle the paperwork behind real estate transactions. They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster. We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated. With today’s advances in AI, we can build agents that handle this operational work and create modern software around how brokerages actually work. We currently sell to brokerages in New Hampshire and are expanding quickly.

yc_guild.name: GUILD
yc_guild.description: GUILD is an AI-Native Defense contractor making aerospace parts faster and cheaper. We win defense contracts, automate manufacturing, and deliver to the government's door.

yc_floracene.name: Floracene
yc_floracene.tagline: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
yc_floracene.description: Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built use

yc_rise-reforming.name: Rise Reforming
yc_rise-reforming.tagline: We turn waste gases into supply-secure chemicals
yc_rise-reforming.description: Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether. Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billi

yc_lyon.name: Lyon
yc_lyon.tagline: Foundation models on enterprise transaction data.
yc_lyon.description: Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, insurance companies, and fintechs. Each model learns from the company’s proprietary transactions, payments, clicks, and customer interactions to predict credit, fraud, collections, income, churn, and lifetime value; and runs inside the company’s cloud, so its data and intelligence remain under its control. Lyon is already working with a major insurer and trained a model on 28B transactions for a fintech serving tens of millions of active users, identifying premium-card converters 4x more precisely than its existing rules; the model is now being deployed for credit.

yc_instaplay.name: Instaplay
yc_instaplay.tagline: AI-native gaming platform turning every game into an RL environment
yc_instaplay.description: Over 25k creators and 130k players are on Instaplay, playing and making games. We work with the leading frontier labs to improve their game generation and coding capabilities.

yc_verdant.name: Verdant
yc_verdant.tagline: AI Agents to Make Local Gov Efficient
yc_verdant.description: Verdant sells AI agents to local government to make them more efficient. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgment. Many startups fail to sell to government, but not us - we've processed 200+ applications and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states with an average close time of 4 weeks.

yc_impact-drones.name: IMPACT Drones
yc_impact-drones.tagline: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
yc_impact-drones.description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letter

yc_insurf.name: Insurf
yc_insurf.tagline: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
yc_insurf.description: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.

yc_jcode.name: Jcode
yc_jcode.description: We produce the most capable, fast, and efficient coding agent harness. Our harness has 20k+ github stars, and $1m+/month of inference throughput.

yc_lemonlime.name: LemonLime
yc_lemonlime.tagline: Fully automated GTM for small business
yc_lemonlime.description: LemonLime runs fully automated sales and marketing for small businesses. Every morning, LemonLime finds you new leads and drafts personalized outreach, prepares branded content, and identifies untapped sales & marketing opportunities. All you have to do is click send.

yc_gutgutgoose.name: Gutgutgoose
yc_gutgutgoose.tagline: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing
yc_gutgutgoose.description: Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself. Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.

yc_speko.name: Speko
yc_speko.tagline: OpenRouter for Voice AI: one API, every call on the best speech model
yc_speko.description: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at previous company, shipping production voice for Fortune 500s.

yc_synapse-semiconductor.name: Synapse Semiconductor
yc_synapse-semiconductor.tagline: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
yc_synapse-semiconductor.description: We want to push machines to where humans cant go. Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

yc_orchestra.name: Orchestra
yc_orchestra.tagline: Self-optimizing neocloud that cuts LLM costs by 100x
yc_orchestra.description: Orchestra is an inference cloud. We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for). Instead of renting the same frontier model forever, your AI infrastructure gets faster, smarter, and cheaper every time it runs. Suppose your product uses Claude for a repetitive legal workflow. Orchestra observes successful production runs, learns the specific tools and judgment required for that workflow, and trains a specialized open-weight model. Once that model matches or beats Claude on a held-out evaluation, Orchestra starts routing production traffic to it. As more work is completed, the mode

yc_rote.name: Rote
yc_rote.tagline: AI-native insurance department for auto body shops
yc_rote.description: Rote handles the entire negotiation lifecycle between shops and insurance companies to help them recover thousands of dollars in denied claims. Shops today lose millions per year because they lack the resources to negotiate with insurance companies that undervalue repair costs. Rote's agents recover denied revenue by taking shop estimates and referencing technical repair data to autonomously file and defend shop claims.

yc_prized.name: Prized
yc_prized.tagline: A cloud devbox that feels local
yc_prized.description: Prized is a cloud development environment that feels local on your Mac. Developers get a dedicated, persistent machine with their repos, dependencies, and tools already configured. Files sync into a real local folder, remote ports appear on localhost, and terminals persist through tmux, so developers and coding agents can keep working even after the laptop closes. Machines can be resized or cloned as workloads grow, without rebuilding the development environment.

yc_studio.name: Studio
yc_studio.tagline: Accurately simulate market response at scale
yc_studio.description: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior data. Our simulations match live KPI outcomes like revenue and purchase behavior with over 97% accuracy for consumer-facing enterprises, higher than any synthetic panel, simulation lab, or traditional market research.

yc_bernard.name: Bernard
yc_bernard.tagline: AI employees that run home appliance repair companies
yc_bernard.description: Bernard builds AI employees for home and commercial appliance servicers. They work across phone, text, email, warranty feeds, and existing systems to manage customer communication, scheduling, and dispatch, carrying each job through diagnosis, parts preparation, technician handoff, and follow-up. At the center is Pre-ID, which combines the exact appliance and its symptoms with repair history, similar completed visits, manufacturer guidance, and parts data to produce a diagnosis, ranked parts, and follow-up questions. Technicians arrive prepared with the right parts, helping servicers complete more repairs on the first visit. We’re building the world’s most efficient appliance servicers, crea

yc_maingen.name: Maingen
yc_maingen.description: Maingen builds simulations for industrial operations ($5 trillion slice of the US economy) so frontier labs can train models that actually run power plants, factories, and datacenters.

yc_enact.name: Enact
yc_enact.tagline: Real-world RL environments for robotics models
yc_enact.description: Enact creates the physical environments to benchmark and hill climb robotics models on high-value tasks. We find where robots fail, and fix them with our in-house training loop.

yc_rex-inc.name: Rex
yc_rex-inc.description: Rex is an AI-native service for order to cash. Rex replaces manual operations with AI agents that continuously manage invoices, customers and exceptions. Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours. We founded Rex after spending four y

yc_zomma.name: Zomma
yc_zomma.tagline: The AI BPO for financial servies, run by computer-use agents
yc_zomma.description: Zomma is building the AI workforce for financial services with computer-use agents that onboard like humans and scale like compute. Its agents handle KYC reviews, transaction alerts, and disputes on the same screens human analysts use, no integration.

yc_nebusec.name: NebuSec
yc_nebusec.tagline: Autonomous AI defense system for cyber attack
yc_nebusec.description: NebuSec is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team. We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser. “Audited by NebuSec” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world’s best hackers.

yc_kara.name: Kara
yc_kara.description: Kara is building diamond semiconductors. We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

yc_palisade.name: Palisade
yc_palisade.tagline: AI-native sales agents that run marketplaces
yc_palisade.description: Palisade spins up a personal sales agent for every single visitor to your website. Marketplaces like trading card platforms, vintage stores, and short-term rental operators sell more when each customer works with a personal agent that remembers them.

yc_trope.name: Trope
yc_trope.tagline: AI FDE that deploys custom AI agents into ERPs
yc_trope.description: Trope deploys custom AI agents into ERPs for mid-market companies. Every ERP is heavily customized, so useful agents need custom deployment too. Trope’s AI FDE learns each business and ERP, then builds and deploys agents, turning the last mile from services into software.

yc_parasma.name: Parasma
yc_parasma.tagline: Replacing GPUs with human brain cells
yc_parasma.description: We train human brain cells for compute

yc_belvedir.name: Belvedir
yc_belvedir.description: Belvedir makes it cheap and easy for anyone to make custom AI models. We autonomously collect your data via trace SDK / app MCP / CUA agents and autonomously train custom models + harnesses + routers, privately deploy them, and recursively improve them as they are used. Our customers have seen 10x reductions in inference costs and 2x increases on benchmark scores. Custom AI models are going to win. Belvedir is the infrastructure needed to make trillions of them.

yc_shielded.name: Shielded
yc_shielded.tagline: We help Fortune 500 companies hedge their supply chain risk
yc_shielded.description: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.

yc_olam-labs.name: Olam Labs
