Tolmo deploys fleets of AI security agents on a live production knowledge graph that connects data from cloud services, containers, databases, and third-party providers (Observability, Security, etc.). Tolmo agents triage, verify impact, and remediate security issues autonomously, escalating to humans only when truly necessary.

yc_openwork.name: OpenWork
yc_openwork.tagline: The open source alternative to Claude Cowork
yc_openwork.description: OpenWork is a desktop app that lets people connect to their existing skills, MCPs, and agents. Users can download the app for free, try it with over 50+ model providers, and easily share their setup with their team.

yc_apollo-atomics-inc.name: Apollo Atomics, Inc.
yc_apollo-atomics-inc.tagline: We make the most compact nuclear reactors

yc_general-aviation.name: General Aviation
yc_general-aviation.tagline: Fixing air traffic control with remote towers
yc_general-aviation.description: Building the elements of a new ATC system.

yc_openprose.name: OpenProse
yc_openprose.tagline: An open-source operating system for reliable long-running agents
yc_openprose.description: OpenProse is building open-source infrastructure for long-running AI work: a declarative language plus a reactive harness/runtime for reliable agent workflows.

yc_asterlab.name: Aster
yc_asterlab.description: Aster is the first autonomous research lab — thousands of AI research agents orchestrated in parallel toward a single goal. We're on a mission to automate open-ended research: research that defines its own problems before it can answer them. The future doesn't wait to be defined by benchmarks. Neither do we.

yc_amboras.name: Amboras
yc_amboras.description: Amboras puts your entire e-commerce on autopilot. It builds your store, continuously optimizes it, reads your analytics, and learns what converts - all autonomously. No developers. No agencies. No guessing. Today it sells to humans. Tomorrow it sells to AI agents.

yc_hessian.name: Hessian
yc_hessian.description: Hessian is the platform for automating business operations with AI agents. We forward deploy on-site to map the work, and build the agents on our platform to run it end-to-end. Unlike off-the-shelf tools that don't know your business, you get a partner that owns the software and operates it every day. Why now? Coding agents have matured to the point where, combined with our engineering judgment we've built across a decade of shipping production systems, we can scale forward-deployed engagements with minimal headcount. Furthermore, our FDE agents and tooling will accelerate how quickly we automate workflows on our platform. We're already saving our customers hundreds of hours a month. Trillio

yc_mentlio.name: Mentlio
yc_mentlio.tagline: Engineering Intelligence and Token Optimization for the AI-Coding Era
yc_mentlio.description: Mentlio an applied research lab focused on optimizing AI ROI for the modern enterprise. We help engineering teams draw a line between their AI spend and delivery, per engineer. We then cut ~30% of AI spend via Mentlio's custom ML-based intelligent routing, context optimization, and prompt compression.

yc_raspire.name: RASPIRE
yc_raspire.description: RASPIRE is the first line of defense for applications against AI-powered fraud attacks, API abuse, and runtime threats. Unlike code scanners and pentesting tools that identify vulnerabilities before release, RASPIRE operates like a security expert running inside applications, monitoring, detecting, and blocking attacks 24/7 in real time. All without writing a single line of code.

yc_plena-health.name: Plena Health
yc_plena-health.tagline: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices
yc_plena-health.description: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices. We automate the administrative workflows that keep clinics running — referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, across all the systems a practice already uses. Unlike point solutions that cover a slice of the problem, Plena becomes the operating layer across the entire practice, connecting the systems, teams, and workflows that keep it running. In 10 months we've grown 17x and crossed seven figures in committed ARR across six specialties and eight states, with 80% of growth through word of mouth.

yc_testerarmy.name: TesterArmy
yc_testerarmy.tagline: Test your app with AI, catch bugs before users do
yc_testerarmy.description: TesterArmy is an AI agent that tests websites and mobile apps. It monitors production on a schedule and runs automatically on every GitHub Pull Request, delivering screenshots, recordings, and actionable bug reports. Describe tests in plain English. The agent handles login flows, OAuth, and OTPs, no scripts to write or maintain. We catch the regressions and UX issues that code review misses.

yc_nxtcure-labs.name: Nxtcure Labs
yc_nxtcure-labs.tagline: The full-stack AI CRO for drug discovery.
yc_nxtcure-labs.description: Reinventing medicine from lab to drug discovery. NxtCure CRO- an AI-native, full-stack CRO built to take therapeutics from discovery to market faster. NxtCure Cancer- the all-in-one mobile platform guiding patients through the cancer journey. We’re building the operating system for the future of medicine.

yc_eden-robotics.name: Eden Robotics
yc_eden-robotics.description: We're building robots that just work and use them to deliver autonomous services at scale. Our first use case is semi-humanoid robots for manufacturing and logistics. Unlike traditional robotics companies, we don't sell robots, we provide physical agents for hire where companies pay for the robots based on usage, decreasing the barrier to entry and expanding the robotics market as a whole.

yc_foaster.name: Foaster
yc_foaster.description: Foaster is building the AI-native McKinsey, starting with AI transformation. We deploy AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in just 2 weeks. Expert consultants review the final outputs, add judgment where it matters, and feed their corrections back into the system. We believe current AI models already have the capabilities required to automate most of the work consultants do. But traditional consulting firms use them to improve the old model: helping consultants work faster. Foaster is instead rebuilding a new model from scratch, where agents do the work that nee

yc_aquashield.name: AquaShield
yc_aquashield.tagline: AI water leak detection for buildings
yc_aquashield.description: AquaShield protects large real estate portfolios against water damage (losses of up to hundreds of millions per year).

yc_ornadyne.name: Ornadyne
yc_ornadyne.tagline: We're building robot birds for surveillance.
yc_ornadyne.description: Ornadyne builds flapping-wing drones for reconnaissance that look, fly, and sound like birds. Today’s drones are easy to detect acoustically, visually, and electronically. As counter-UAS systems improve, traditional quadcopters and fixed-wing UAS systems are becoming increasingly ineffective for close-range surveillance. Flapping-wing aircraft have existed for years, but have lacked the performance, endurance, and control required for real-world deployment. We’re changing that by engineering a high-performance, stealth-optimized system built from first principles for efficiency, autonomy, and reliable field use. The final frontier of surveillance won’t look like machines; it will look like w

yc_anoria.name: ANORIA
yc_anoria.tagline: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
yc_anoria.description: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.

yc_abinitio-bio.name: AbInitio Bio
yc_abinitio-bio.tagline: The Intelligence layer for Drug Manufacturing
yc_abinitio-bio.description: Abinitio Bio builds foundation models for biomanufacturing, validated against wet lab data. Our first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes more accurately than standard models, and any pharma or CDMO can adapt it to their own workflow instantly. By making process decisions that take 6-18 months today in hours, we help teams avoid the cost of delay on a single program.

yc_memory-store.name: Memory Store
yc_memory-store.description: One memory for your team's agents. Turn every meeting, Claude session, and Slack chat into context your team and agents share.

yc_saudara-ai.name: Saudara AI
yc_saudara-ai.tagline: AI Native Sourcing Broker For Overseas Manufacturing
yc_saudara-ai.description: Saudara AI is an AI sourcing broker connecting American brands with vetted overseas factories. US brands import $3T in goods a year and lose billions to ghost suppliers, hidden fees, and blown deadlines. The factories that actually deliver sit behind decades-old relationships outsiders can't break into. We were born into them. Every deal runs through a real human broker, supercharged by AI that handles sourcing, quoting, QC, logistics and vendor financing. 10x faster, at a fraction of the cost. Sourcing is the largest broken market in global trade. We're the on-ramp.

yc_pops.name: Pops
yc_pops.tagline: Create & play AI games with friends
yc_pops.description: Pops lets people play, remix, and share AI games with friends. Discover an infinite feed of games, challenges, quizzes, and other fun interactive experiences made by others. Every play instantly becomes a funny gameplay/reaction video you can send to friends, post online, or use to challenge someone to beat your score. For creators, Pops makes it easier than ever to bring ideas to life and get them played. Instead of learning complex game engines, writing code, or fighting for distribution, anyone can create or remix a playable game in seconds. Bring your ideas, and Pops brings the audience.

yc_silmaril.name: Silmaril
yc_silmaril.description: Silmaril is the first security for agents that self-improves. It understands application context to block 2x as many threats as current SOTA defenses with 10x lower latency. Customers plug us into agentic frameworks like LangGraph with 5 lines of code. Silmaril has stopped $28M of damages for customers.

yc_biostack-platforms.name: BioStack Platforms
yc_biostack-platforms.tagline: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
yc_biostack-platforms.description: BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments. We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack

yc_ardent.name: Ardent
yc_ardent.description: Clone any postgres DB regardless of size in 6s so agents can test their work

yc_kuli.name: Kuli
yc_kuli.tagline: AI coworker for marketing teams at the largest consumer brands
yc_kuli.description: Kuli is an AI coworker for marketing teams at the world's largest consumer brands. Our agent watches all videos across social media, learns the brand's context and helps them turn signals from billions of social videos into winning campaigns without increasing headcount. Previous platforms gave marketers databases to search through and a CRM. Kuli actually watches the content. Marketers at team like Disney, Nivea and PostHog use it to scout creators, run analysis on trends and competitor strategies, and analyse what makes their campaign perform better. For 10 years, influencer marketing meant more tools, more tabs, more spreadsheets. Kuli replaces all of that with one single agent you orches

yc_wato.name: Wato
yc_wato.tagline: The control point for AI agents at work.
yc_wato.description: Wato gives AI agents shared memory, reusable workflows, connected tools, and living artifacts so work compounds across a team instead of disappearing into chat threads. Teams use Wato to give every agent access to trusted company context and turn useful runs into knowledge the next agent can build on.

yc_tasklet-2.name: Tasklet
yc_tasklet-2.description: AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated. Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk op

yc_chronicle-labs.name: Chronicle Labs
yc_chronicle-labs.tagline: Staging Environments for Enterprise AI Agents
yc_chronicle-labs.description: Chronicle Labs is a staging environment for enterprise AI agents: we capture every event the agent sees in production and backtest it, so customers can safely test new behaviors without breaking anything.

yc_walter.name: Walter
yc_walter.description: Walter is an AI employee for manufacturing operations.

yc_aseon-labs.name: Aseon Labs
yc_aseon-labs.description: Aseon Labs builds robotic pitstops for self-driving cars. Autonomous vehicles can drive themselves, but they still rely on humans and centralized depots for charging, cleaning and servicing multiple times per day. As fleets scale, the operational layer makes up 70% of the cost of the service and is of the largest barrier to uptime, profitability and market expansion. Aseon Pods are robotic micro-depots that can be deployed directly within operating zones, bringing fleet servicing to where demand exists. By eliminating unnecessary depot trips and automating routine operations, Aseon helps autonomous fleet operators increase uptime, reduce reset cost by 50% and unlock scale. Founded by the tea

yc_soria.name: Soria
yc_soria.tagline: AI Financial Research Terminal built for Healthcare (and beyond)
yc_soria.description: Soria is an AI-native Financial Terminal for investors who specialize in a particular sector, starting with healthcare. Our agents convert hundreds of the most important public and private sources into an always-on financial model, reviewed by domain experts and delivered to hedge funds, banks, and asset managers through a terminal UI, MCP, API, warehouse sync, and research feed. Unlike our competitors, we own the data layer and expand bottom-up, one sector at a time - additionally our agents proactively do research on behalf of our clients without them lifting a finger or sharing any data.

yc_armature.name: Armature
yc_armature.tagline: We get your product picked by coding agents.
yc_armature.description: Coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor now decide which tools get installed in a codebase. Armature runs the real agents inside a panel of realistic repositories, measures whether they pick you, and works with your team on the docs, SDK and content changes that make them choose you. Every change is tested on real agent runs before it ships. Once agents use your product, Armature shows you what users do with it through AI, with self-serve MCP analytics and evals that catch regressions before your users see them.

yc_collar.name: Collar
yc_collar.description: Collar helps lean investor relations teams reach the right investors. We automate earnings preparation, track peers and market developments, and target investors who best fit each company. CFOs and IR heads can actually focus on building relationships and getting their company’s story heard.

yc_plan0-ai.name: PLAN0 AI
yc_plan0-ai.description: PLAN0 is building the Bloomberg of construction for real estate developers, investors, and general contractors — $30B of projects are already running through the platform. We analyze architectural plans using vision models to generate detailed cost estimates and analytics in minutes. Through industry partnerships, the platform also aggregates historical and real-time project data across all major geographies to power ML-driven analytics, decomposing costs into market-observable factors and creating an agentic layer for cost optimization.

yc_zibra-labs.name: Zibra Labs
yc_zibra-labs.tagline: Distributed runtime for AI workloads at scale
yc_zibra-labs.description: We build distributed compute clusters with the cheapest CPUs and GPUs across Hyperscalers and Neoclouds for AI. Our mission is to bring frontier-grade infrastructure to everyone. We're starting by building large scale high performance computing (HPC) clusters for quantitative trading firms to run parallel simulation workloads such as backtesting. Our technology generalizes to critical AI workloads such as post-training with reinforcement learning, fine-tuning, long-horizon agents with high tool use, and batch inference.

yc_reason-machines.name: Reason Machines
yc_reason-machines.tagline: Reason Machines builds Reason Agent, the autonomous software engineer…
yc_reason-machines.description: Reason Machines builds Reason Agent, the autonomous software engineer for engineering teams. Reason connects to GitHub, reproduces bugs, writes code, passes tests, and ships review-ready pull requests with recordings and logs across cloud environments.

yc_valctrl.name: ValCtrl
yc_valctrl.tagline: ValCtrl is building the only intelligent prediction market
yc_valctrl.description: ValCtrl is building the intelligent prediction market: users type any public, resolvable belief about the future, ValCtrl structures it, prices it, and lets them trade it. Today’s prediction markets only support pre-listed questions, leaving user beliefs fragmented across venues, contract wording, rules, and proxy markets. ValCtrl’s world model maps typed beliefs to relevant market signals, evaluates basis risk, prices the claim, and moves toward model-priced liquidity where ValCtrl can take the other side with risk and compliance controls. We are starting from hard belief-to-market queries and building toward a market where anything that can be resolved can be priced.

yc_tdaycom.name: tday.com
yc_tdaycom.tagline: AI that turns your product into on-brand marketing content
yc_tdaycom.description: tday automatically turns a software company's product into on-brand marketing creative. Connect your product and git repo, and tday generates polished launch videos, social graphics, and ads, the content a team would normally spend hours making in a design tool or pay a freelancer for. tday then publishes the creative and measures how it performs across your social and ad channels, closing the loop from what you ship to what you post.

yc_e1o.name: E1O
yc_e1o.tagline: Camera-free AI glasses. Your AI, out in the world.
yc_e1o.description: E1O (E1 Optics) is building camera-free AI glasses with a private display and a personal assistant. Follow your coding agents, catch up on email, and bring useful information into view. Connected to the E1O app on your phone. Join the early-access waitlist at e1o.com.

yc_minicor.name: Minicor
yc_minicor.description: Minicor connects AI startups to legacy desktop apps that have no API. Reliably, quickly and at scale. Describe a workflow and get an API endpoint. Each call triggers a self-healing desktop automation on a Windows VM. On-prem, cloud, or Citrix. Build through your coding agent via our MCP. Complete with the observability tools to manage your customer relationship: full video replay of every automation, granular logging, and slack enabled alerts.

yc_degla-inc.name: Degla Inc
yc_degla-inc.tagline: The fully autonomous intelligence layer in the sky.
yc_degla-inc.description: We turn natural Language into Multi-Drone Mission execution. Degla is built around a simple idea: once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.You don’t babysit drones. You don’t micromanage failures. You don’t rewrite plans. You state the goal, Degla figures out how.

yc_archer.name: Archer
yc_archer.tagline: Global payouts for the workforce powering AI
yc_archer.description: Archer is the financial infrastructure for the AI data economy. We’re building global payouts, stablecoin banking, and yield infrastructure for the companies supplying data to frontier AI labs. As demand for high-quality data grows, millions of contributors around the world are generating, labeling, validating, and improving the datasets that power modern AI systems. Yet the financial infrastructure behind these platforms remains slow, fragmented, and expensive. Archer enables data marketplaces, AI labor platforms, and reinforcement learning environment providers to onboard workers globally, pay contributors instantly, and earn yield on idle balances. yc_river-markets.name: River Markets
yc_river-markets.description: River Markets is the prime brokerage for prediction markets. We aggregate every major event-contract venue into one account, giving professional traders best execution, portfolio and order management systems, and a unified API.

yc_smol-machines.name: smol machines
yc_smol-machines.tagline: Ship software faster with portable, self contained virtual machines.
yc_smol-machines.description: Smol machines solve the problem of "but app works on my machine" by shipping the machine. Smol machine enables devs to ship a lightweight virtual machine with any software, similar to how Electron ships an entire browser with the web app.

yc_allowance.name: Allowance
yc_allowance.tagline: The spend control layer for AI agents
yc_allowance.description: Allowance lets AI agents make purchases on a user’s behalf without ever exposing your real card number. Users approve purchases directly from their iPhone with customizable controls like spending limits, merchant restrictions, and expiration windows. Once approved, Allowance generates scoped, one-time payment credentials designed specifically for that transaction. This enables AI agents to safely complete tasks like shopping, ordering food, booking reservations, or purchasing tickets while keeping humans in control of every payment.

yc_runharbor.name: Harbor
yc_runharbor.tagline: AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations
yc_runharbor.description: Harbor is building an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) for clinical trials. We started with an AI-native system of record for clinical trial data (electronic data capture system), grew the software business to seven trials and ~$187k in contracted software revenue over the next twelve months, then expanded into full-service trial execution and signed our first CRO contract worth $1.93M over three years. Clinical trials consume 45% of all new drug and device development spend. yc_complir.name: Complir
yc_complir.description: AI-powered product compliance platform that makes it easy for retailers to launch and scale products across borders without drowning in regulatory work. Complir's AI agents handle the regulations and documentation across every market you sell in - and keep your entire catalogue audit-ready.

yc_aice.name: AICE

yc_infera.name: Infera

yc_mount.name: Mount
yc_mount.description: TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them. Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more. Legacy insurance was not built for this. yc_useparrot.name: Parrot
yc_useparrot.tagline: Agentic operating system for auto repair shops
yc_useparrot.description: Parrot is an agentic OS that understands your business so it can call, negotiate, and coordinate with real humans.

yc_result.name: Result
yc_result.tagline: Where new internet entrepreneurs build and run their companies
yc_result.description: Result is where the next generation of founders start and run their companies. In one place, you incorporate, open accounts, take payments, launch a product, and run the operational work of the business: marketing campaigns, customer support, content production, and growth experiments, with agents inside Result helping the founder do the work.

yc_textsidekick.name: Sidekick
yc_textsidekick.tagline: AI agent that manages manufacturing operations over text
yc_textsidekick.description: Sidekick is an AI agent that runs custom manufacturing operations over text. Workers text a problem, photo, video, or voice memo and get an answer from the shop's own documents. It reads live machine data and acts on its own: flagging issues before they become downtime, opening and routing work orders, and placing purchase orders. No app, no login. These shops run on tribal knowledge: a handful of veterans know how every job is set up, and they are retiring. Sidekick learns from every message it handles, so answers outlive the people who gave them, and shops run 15% more jobs with the same crew. Sidekick captures it as a byproduct of the work, in an industry that was never documented.

yc_lumius.name: Lumius
yc_lumius.tagline: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
yc_lumius.description: Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable. We

yc_adialante.name: Adialante
yc_adialante.description: We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.

yc_savant.name: Savant
yc_savant.tagline: Company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on
yc_savant.description: Savant is the company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on. We plug into the tools you already use, capture the written knowledge / undocumented procedures, and serve them to your employees and agents at decision time.

yc_keyframe-labs.name: Keyframe Labs
yc_keyframe-labs.tagline: Bring AI to life with the world's best interactive avatars
yc_keyframe-labs.description: We build human foundation models. Our first family of models powers lifelike avatars that interact with users in real time, enabling AI agents and applications to go beyond text and voice with just a few lines of code. State-of-the-art realism with ultra-low latency at scale.

yc_voquill.name: Voquill
yc_voquill.tagline: The agentic OS for medical labs
yc_voquill.description: Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker. Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.

yc_oddpool.name: Oddpool
yc_oddpool.description: Oddpool is a platform that helps quant funds and trading desks harness the power of prediction markets. Avi and Ritesh have been roommates since freshman year at Georgia Tech. Ritesh has a Master's in Distributed Systems and made buy-side trading systems at Bloomberg 40% faster.

yc_ontora.name: Ontora
yc_ontora.tagline: AI agents that interviews every employee to hand context to AI tools.

yc_napkin-math.name: Napkin Math
yc_napkin-math.tagline: AI nutrition coach in your pocket
yc_napkin-math.description: Napkin Math is the personalized AI food journal that people love to use. We gamify nutrition tracking so people are 2x more likely to stick with us than other trackers. But they don’t answer the questions you actually have. Food is deeply personal, and so is Napkin Math: Get the fuel you need for marathon training, while understanding you eat catered office lunches five days a week. Discover what’s triggering your stomach irritation, without sacrificing

yc_gojiberry-ai.name: Gojiberry AI
yc_gojiberry-ai.tagline: AI Go-To-Market agents for B2B teams
yc_gojiberry-ai.description: Gojiberry is building the AI GTM team for B2B companies. We start with outbound: Gojiberry finds buyers showing intent, enriches them, reaches out, follows up, handles replies, and books qualified meetings. Companies use Gojiberry to replace the old way of doing outbound: buying tools, hiring SDRs & agencies, testing lists, writing messages, and guessing what works. Gojiberry turns it into one AI team that finds buyers and books meetings. Every campaign makes Gojiberry smarter. It learns which buyers convert, which signals matter, which messages get replies, and which actions create revenue. yc_wondertx.name: WonderTx

yc_wondertx.description: We’re an AI-native biotech, working on replacing needles with pills. Many drugs, like insulin or Ozempic, are wonderful except you have to inject them. We discover new molecules that you can take as a pill instead. Because the pills operate on biology which has been shown to be effective in people, rather than merely in animal models of disease, we avoid what has historically been the single biggest risk in drug discovery. This should dramatically increase our probability of success. yc_lab0.tagline: AI FDEs to make your B2B SaaS Go Live in Days, not Months
yc_lab0.description: Enterprise software implementation is broken, and it has been for decades. Every rollout, whether it's a traditional ERP or a new AI system, requires months of manual integration, configuration, and tuning done by armies of system integrators and forward-deployed engineers. Lab0 builds agentic systems that automate this layer, compressing months-long implementations into weeks.

yc_bentolabs-ai.name: BentoLabs AI
yc_bentolabs-ai.tagline: Monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents
yc_bentolabs-ai.description: BentoLabs is the monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents. We detect when agents silently fail or drift from the user's goal, system prompt, or tool contracts, show affected users and root cause, and suggest the prompt, skill, or harness fix. As more teams deploy agents, keeping them reliable in production becomes mission-critical. Bento sits directly in the production loop and gives teams the operational leverage required to scale agent ecosystems without scaling human firefighting alongside them. The result is a system that turns opaque agents into agents that can be monitored, debugged, and improved continuously. The founders learned this problem at Emergent (YC S24), where t

yc_lamina-labs.name: Lamina Labs
yc_lamina-labs.description: Lamina Labs is building infrastructure for near-real-time structured video generation. Most AI video is built for cinematic clips. Lamina is built for useful videos that break down ideas, workflows, and AI answers. Our first product, Simi, turns prompts and documents into whiteboard-style explainer videos in seconds

yc_kimpton.name: Kimpton
yc_kimpton.tagline: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work
yc_kimpton.description: In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it. Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on. The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding

yc_stablebrowse.name: StableBrowse
yc_stablebrowse.tagline: Building the Data Infrastructure layer for Physical AI.

yc_taiga.name: Taiga
yc_taiga.description: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.

yc_pairio.name: Pairio
yc_pairio.tagline: AI mobile app that helps factory technicians fix broken machines
yc_pairio.description: Pairo is an AI mobile app to help technicians fix broken equipment in factories. Users just take a picture of the broken machine and we search thousands of pages of manuals to find the right solution.

yc_callab-ai.name: Callab AI
yc_callab-ai.tagline: AI voice agents for on-prem telephony stack.
yc_callab-ai.description: 58% of the $400B call center industry runs on on-prem phone systems, and until now bringing AI voice automation to them meant ripping out their entire infrastructure first. That's the largest unserved segment in the market. Callab AI connects directly to legacy PBX systems like Avaya, Cisco UCM, and Mitel, and automates up to 70% of call volume with zero migration needed. We plug into these environments without requiring a rip-and-replace. We serve clients across three continents, including brands like Dunkin Donuts.

yc_synphony.name: Synphony
yc_synphony.description: Strawberry farming is a $3B industry in California alone with 60% labor cost using 40-year old software. Synphony provides strawberry picking robots and software services including: bed-level analytics, data pipeline integration, and agentic solutions. Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products

yc_dreach.name: Dreach
yc_dreach.tagline: staffing firms with dreach grow revenue faster.
yc_dreach.description: dreach watches your ATS and your network. when someone starts hiring, you get the manager who owns the role and your warmest way in.

yc_arga-labs.name: Arga Labs
yc_arga-labs.tagline: Real-world sandboxes to test and train AI agents
yc_arga-labs.description: We build environments to test your app and agents against the real world. Deploy your code/agent into a sandbox that runs against replicas of external services (Stripe, Slack, Google Drive, etc.). Twins support the same APIs, MCP tool calls & SDKs as the real software, and you can spin up thousands of instances in parallel and seed them using natural language. Run real workflows, surface edge cases, and observe how your code/agents actually behave before hitting production.

yc_andco.name: Andco
yc_andco.tagline: Agents that build personal injury cases
yc_andco.description: Our agents retrieve and synthesize all the records law firms need to start a personal injury case. We get police reports, open insurance claims, and retrieve all the medical records and bills needed to build a case.

yc_rentahuman.name: RentAHuman
yc_rentahuman.tagline: Marketplace for AI agents to hire humans.

yc_instaagent.name: InstaAgent
yc_instaagent.tagline: Scale marketing campaigns across hundreds of personas
yc_instaagent.description: InstaAgent helps B2C companies scale a single campaign across hundreds of specific audiences on Meta and TikTok, each with its own content, voice, and targeting. Traction: $1M Ann. Run Rate in 10 months. From one brief, we create personalized creatives, distribute them through paid channels and niche social accounts, and use performance data to learn what works, scale winners, and improve every campaign.

yc_antinuous.name: Antinuous
yc_antinuous.tagline: Autonomous research agents for R&D and education
yc_antinuous.description: Antinuous is building autonomous research agents to help people in research, development, discovery, and knowledge work do faster, more accurate research end to end without a human in the loop. We believe humans should be able to ask a single question, and no matter how simple or complex, agents should look at the question, break it down, research the answer, test new ideas, simulate new environments, and repeat autonomously using as much or little compute as necessary elastically.

yc_sherpa.name: Sherpa
yc_sherpa.description: Sherpa automatically optimizes websites for every human and every agent. For humans, Sherpa studies visitor behavior, builds better pages and flows, tests them on live traffic, and keeps what converts. For AI agents, Sherpa tests different agent-facing versions of the site until agents recommend the company more often. Customers typically see a 15-20% lift in their primary conversion metric after using Sherpa for 30 days.

yc_userlens.name: Userlens
yc_userlens.tagline: Let agents talk to your customers
yc_userlens.description: Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale. Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use. Most teams still rely on onboarding flows, lifecycle emails, support docs, and reactive CSM outreach. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Lumi watches how users actually use your product, spots when they’re ready for the next feature, workflow, or habit, and nudges them at exactly the rig

yc_transload.name: transload
yc_transload.description: transload helps logistics companies measure shipments using the security cameras they already have. A pallet, a couch, a tire – we capture its true size as it moves through the warehouse. For our customers, 15% of shipments turn out to be bigger than what the sender claimed. Catching those differences is worth ~$50k per site per month in rebillings and improved trailer utilization.

yc_standout.name: Standout
yc_standout.description: Standout gives every talent and company an autonomous agent that represents them, assess the other side, and makes intros when it matters. Why it matters? Because this is hiring today: - Talent use AI to apply to 100s of jobs - this is spam. - Founders/Recruiting send 100s of AI-generated messages to hire the same talent - this is spam. This has to stop. Talent stays fully anonymous until they accept an intro. The best way for passively exploring the market and not missing a life changing opportunity. In 1 month, 10k talent / 60 companies / 100 intros.

yc_shotwellai.name: shotwell.ai
yc_shotwellai.description: Shotwell AI is building the data QA layer for dexterous robotics. We work with teams collecting teleoperation and egocentric data to provide dense semantic annotation and validate task adherence. This lets teams compress feedback loops from weeks to hours and iterate on models much faster.

yc_madrone.name: Madrone
yc_madrone.description: Madrone builds cooling systems for data centers. In Texas, where most new sites are, Madrone can cool using 30% less power and water, thanks to novel dew-point cooling technology.

yc_pavoot.name: Pavoot
yc_pavoot.tagline: AI Event Manager for in-person events
yc_pavoot.description: Pavoot is an AI event manager for companies that run in-person customer events. More and more companies are investing in dinners, summits, and community events because relationships drive revenue. But today, running events means sourcing attendees, sending invitations, hosting the event, and then manually digging through notes, emails, and spreadsheets afterward to figure out who attended, what was discussed, who is a strong lead, and who should be followed up with. Most teams either send generic "thanks for coming" emails or never properly capture the value created during the event. Pavoot replaces this fragmented workflow with a single AI system that keeps every attendee, interaction, conv

yc_qomplement.name: qomplement
yc_qomplement.tagline: The Agentic ERP for supply chain operations
yc_qomplement.description: qomplement is the agentic ERP for retail and logistics companies. Retail and logistics are the industries with the highest volume of transactions in the world. POs, freight invoices, inventory updates, and shipment confirmations. Every single one still requires a person to process it manually. Their only solution has been hiring more people. Legacy ERPs were built for humans. qomplement is the agentic ERP that cuts 95% of manual work and handles 100x more transactions with the same headcount. We give procurement and operations teams superpowers: automating purchase order intake, vendor onboarding, item master updates, freight order processing, carrier invoicing, three-way matching, and inven

yc_deep-interactions.name: Deep Interactions
yc_deep-interactions.tagline: Collaborative AI app builder for teams
yc_deep-interactions.description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative AI builder. We don't leave you with a spaghetti mess of a code. We bring product intelligence and power the context layer that enables your team to build in sync - saving companies tokens, time, and nerves. You give us a problem and we ship a working AI product in the same afternoon.

yc_kelai.name: KelAI
yc_kelai.tagline: The AI Quant: Autonomous Alpha Engine for Funds and Traders.
yc_kelai.description: Founded by former WorldQuant portfolio manager & head of event driven systematic strategies Jeremie Cohen, KelAI is building the autonomous alpha engine for hedge funds, traders and institutional investors. Investment teams now have more data, tools and compute than ever, but research still runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. KelAI turns that fragmented process into a compounding AI-native engine that continuously finds, tests and validates trading signals at a pace no human team can match.

yc_hevn-inc.name: HEVN, inc
yc_hevn-inc.tagline: Cross-border payments for exporters of physical goods.
yc_hevn-inc.description: HEVN is a B2B financial platform built for global commerce. We solve the last-mile problem in cross-border payments by working with licensed local payment service providers and settling transactions through domestic payment rails instead of relying on international bank transfers. HEVN helps importers and exporters move money between jurisdictions with fewer intermediaries and faster, more predictable settlement.

yc_elyra.name: Elyra
yc_elyra.description: Elyra is an AI reservation system for restaurants. Instead of missing 40% of incoming phone calls and taking days to reply to emails, leaving over $100,000 in bookings on the table every year, restaurants get AI agents that answer every call and email instantly, 24/7, connected to a reservation system that optimizes table placements in real time so empty seats get filled with the right guests. Felix and Alan met in primary school in Stockholm and have been building things together ever since. We launched with a single restaurant and within weeks they hit record occupancy, bookings they used to miss were suddenly being captured automatically, and empty Tuesday nights started filling up. Today

yc_interfaze.name: Interfaze
yc_interfaze.tagline: AI model built for high accuracy deterministic tasks
yc_interfaze.description: Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with transformers for tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like Document intelligence, Object detection, Classification, Audio understanding and more. Interfaze outperforms large lab models like Gemini flash, Claude Sonnet and the GPT-5.4 mini series Architecture paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04101 Full open benchmarks: https://interfaze.ai/leaderboards

yc_zolvo.name: Zolvo
yc_zolvo.tagline: AI Back-Office Automation for Commercial Lenders
yc_zolvo.description: Commercial lenders manage billions in assets on legacy software and manual workflows, their systems live on people’s heads like its the 90s. Zolvo replaces the entire back office with AI: automated data ingestion, invoice reconciliation, collections outreach, and funder monitoring. Our clients go live in weeks and eliminate hours of daily manual work per operator, allowing teams to only handle exceptions. We're building the future of commercial lending.

yc_juno-chat.name: Juno
yc_juno-chat.tagline: AI Health Assistant for Chronic Illness
yc_juno-chat.description: Juno is an AI personal health assistant for the 1B+ people living with chronic illness. Launched in October, Juno now supports 150,000+ patients globally.

yc_kinro.name: Kinro
yc_kinro.tagline: Autonomous insurance brokerage for small businesses
yc_kinro.description: We help small business owners get the right coverage.

yc_govguard.name: GovGuard
yc_govguard.tagline: Automating Government Workflows, starting with FOIA
yc_govguard.description: GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA requests. Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.

yc_superlog.name: Superlog
yc_superlog.description: Sentry and Datadog dump a stream of alerts. Most are duplicates, most lack context, and you still have to solve the issue yourself. Superlog is AI-native observability that's meant not to be opened. A wizard scans your repo and installs proper OpenTelemetry instrumentation, then runs daily to keep up as you ship new code. When something breaks, Superlog groups the errors into a single incident, investigates with full context (logs, traces, recent deploys, past Slack threads), and posts one mergeable PR in Slack. You merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code session and modify it. Telemetry is vendor-neutral, so you keep every log, trace, and metric we install, even if you leave.

yc_godhands.name: GodHands
yc_godhands.tagline: We reconstruct how employees actually work, so nothing breaks when…
yc_godhands.description: GodHands makes employee transitions seamless and ensures that critical knowledge is captured for posterity. We reconstruct any employee’s work in days from the systems where they did it. You can see what depends on them, hand their role over, and keep their work running after they leave.

yc_limrun.name: Limrun
yc_limrun.tagline: Extend cloud sandboxes with iOS, Android and more
yc_limrun.description: Coding agents in the cloud don't work for majority of teams who require native capabilities; they lack XCode for iOS, Emulator for Android, Unity for game development teams. We are on a mission to cloudify every local development utility so that regardless of where it runs, your agent can compose an ideal set of capabilities on the fly so you don't need to run it on your laptop. Today, we provide remote services such as XCode, iOS & Android simulators to enable coding agents running in any sandbox to be able to build and iterate over mobile apps, too. Replit, Rork, Momentic, Minitap and more agent companies have built mobile development and testing experiences on Limrun platform. Coconote (Q

yc_light-anchor.name: Light Anchor
yc_light-anchor.description: Light Anchor (YC P26) builds AI-run consumer brands that run at the speed of compute. Consumer brands have always been limited by the speed of humans: hiring, coordinating, and sleeping. AI agents that now run operations end-to-end break all those constraints, making a new kind of consumer business possible: one capped by compute, not headcount. Today, Light Anchor operates one flagship brand and multiple experiment stores, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. The vision is thousands of consumer businesses, operating with little to no human intervention.

yc_hub.name: Hub
yc_hub.tagline: Real-world training data for frontier AI labs and robotics.
yc_hub.description: Hub is a multimodal lab providing real world data to frontier labs and robotic companies.

yc_tenet-industries.name: Tenet Industries
yc_tenet-industries.description: Tenet Industries is building AI-automated factories for manufacturing of PCBAs. We're using AI and robotics to build a factory in München for instant-quote, fast-turnaround PCBA manufacturing and electronic manufacturing services.

yc_atrisa.name: Atrisa
yc_atrisa.tagline: AI Agents for Analog Circuit Design
yc_atrisa.description: AI Agents to build, debug and automate analog circuit design

yc_trellistech.name: Trellis
yc_trellistech.tagline: Agents that run short-term rental operations end-to-end
yc_trellistech.description: Trellis is building toward a new hospitality platform: one that does not just help guests find homes, but actually operates them with agents. Our first wedge is short-term rental property managers, replacing their fragmented stack across guest messages, tasks, cleaners, maintenance, vendors, and owner updates with agents that run operations end-to-end. In two months, we’ve grown to $500k ARR across 35 customers and 3000 listings, growing around 15% week over week, with one customer already running day-to-day operations with no human involved.

yc_the-company-company.name: The Company Company
yc_the-company-company.tagline: The last agent your company will ever need.
yc_the-company-company.description: The Company Company builds the agent and the infrastructure to run companies.

yc_dayjob.name: Dayjob
yc_dayjob.tagline: AI Scheduling for Short Haul Trucks
yc_dayjob.description: Dayjob does AI Scheduling for Short Haul Trucks. Our scheduling agent plugs into existing ERPs and continuously re-optimises routes in real time - handling new jobs, driver changes, and exceptions automatically. Customers in waste management see 8%+ efficiency gains from day one.

yc_inloop-robotics.name: InLoop Robotics
yc_inloop-robotics.tagline: Robotic arms that pick and pack your orders.
yc_inloop-robotics.description: We are building AI-native fulfillment powered by robotics. Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order. Most robotics companies wait until their system is perfect before deploying. We don't. We ship imperfect policies into real warehouses, detect failures in real time, recover automatically when we can, and bring in a remote human operator when we can't. Every failure becomes training data. Every intervention makes the system better. The result is a fulfillment system that continuously learns from production.

yc_zenbu-2.name: Zenbu
yc_zenbu-2.tagline: The extensible IDE for coding agents
yc_zenbu-2.description: Zenbu is an extensible IDE for orchestrating coding agents. Shape it around exactly how you and your team work.

yc_nine-fives.name: Nine Fives
yc_nine-fives.tagline: RF test equipment for next-gen spacecraft, drones, and cellphones
yc_nine-fives.description: Nine Fives produces modern radio frequency test equipment and solutions to disrupt the $130B test equipment industry. By combining modern electronics, AI ready test automation, and strategic supply chains, we’re equipping our customers to cut their time to market in half.

yc_chert.name: Chert
yc_chert.description: Chert provides the infrastructure for businesses to automate conversations over iMessage. We’re already working with B2C startups, customer experience teams, and sales teams to reach end users through trusted and conversational messaging.

yc_saffron.name: Saffron
yc_saffron.description: Saffron allows companies to quickly evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code. The way engineers write code has fundamentally changed, but the way companies evaluate them hasn't. Saffron gives teams full visibility into how candidates use AI agents to build, debug, and ship real features on an actual codebase. Saffron was founded by Robert Chondro (formerly MIT and Jane Street), Jerry Yao (Stanford and Jane Street), and Kazuma Choji (Harvey Mudd, published in NeurIPS and ICML), and is backed by Y Combinator (P26) and Afore Capital.

yc_discovered-materials.name: Discovered Materials
yc_discovered-materials.tagline: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.
yc_discovered-materials.description: We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents. Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies. Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs ne

yc_lightsprint.name: LightSprint
yc_lightsprint.description: Lightsprint is a collaborative software factory for product teams to plan visually, preview live and ship with an army of cloud agents. Your whole team, including non-engineers, can now ship end to end reliably. The company is founded by Ben Ong, an AI investor who previously scaled AI products at SEA Group (NYSE: SE) and Temasek ($300B fund), Benedict Chan who was VP Engineering at Chainlink and CTO at BitGo (NYSE:BTGO), and Heng Hong Lee who built Facebook Messenger in 2013 and was Director of Engineering at Fazz (YC S17).

yc_twolabs.name: Twolabs
yc_twolabs.description: We build modular humanoid robots and the software platform that allows anyone to train, deploy, and scale robots for real-world tasks. Today, teaching a robot a new skill requires robotics engineers, machine learning engineers, training infrastructure, and significant compute resources. We reduce that process to: Record → Upload → Train → Deploy. Our robots are modular and configurable, with interchangeable end effectors, configurable sensors, and multiple deployment configurations. We believe current humanoid embodiments are often overfit for specific use cases, so we're building a platform that adapts to different environments and applications. Long term, we want robotics to be as accessib

yc_marker.name: Marker
yc_marker.tagline: Platform + FDEs that rebuild enterprises agent-first
yc_marker.description: Marker is a platform for rebuilding enterprises agent-first, delivered by forward-deployed engineers. It productizes every step from discovery to production, so every agent we ship makes the next one faster.

yc_scope.name: Scope
yc_scope.tagline: We help software companies get discovered and used by AI agents
yc_scope.description: Scope is the system companies use to measure and improve how agents discover, interact and use their product. As more products gets used through AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar agents, agents are starting to influence which tools get chosen, how they get set up, and whether they keep getting used. Most companies still cannot see that process clearly. We run real workflows across agents and show teams when the agent picks them versus a competitor, where it breaks, where docs or product surfaces confuse the agent, and what to change to get better results and a better agent experience. I started Scope after working on interpretability research for closed-source models at

yc_hexa.name: Hexa
yc_hexa.description: Hexa helps industrial distributors automate their sales and procurement workflows to quote faster and win more bids.

yc_palette-2.name: Palette
yc_palette-2.tagline: The Media Engine of the AI Era
yc_palette-2.description: Palette is a self-improving AI-native media platform built by MIT computer scientists and multimodal researchers that unifies the creative workflow into a single generation engine. We’re building a fully autonomous production engine that generates, distributes, and optimizes interactive media for every brand and audience.

yc_rudus.name: Rudus
yc_rudus.description: Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform enabling concrete contractors to win 3x more projects yearly. It automatically identifies every concrete structure like footings, walls, columns, and slabs on plans, eliminating the manual work and reducing estimation time by 70%. Concrete is the most-used material on earth after water, and demand is surging with the AI infrastructure boom.

yc_replicas.name: Replicas
yc_replicas.tagline: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud
yc_replicas.description: Replicas is a cloud coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from the app, Slack, Linear, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets. Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.

yc_multiplier.name: Multiplier
yc_multiplier.description: Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform. Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application. Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is

yc_most-robotic.name: Most Robotic
yc_most-robotic.tagline: Research lab building the most robotic household in the world
yc_most-robotic.description: We're a robotics research lab pushing what's possible with physical AI. We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with robotics research backgrounds and industry experience at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

yc_illume-labs.name: Illume Labs
yc_illume-labs.description: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.

yc_memoir.name: Memoir
yc_memoir.tagline: Everything your team ships, explained to everyone it affects.
yc_memoir.description: Memoir is building a persistent and proactive AI teammate that helps an entire company keep up with its own progress. Think Instinct but for enterprise. We’re starting with product changes. When engineering ships something, Memoir understands who it affects and creates what each audience needs: a walkthrough for a customer, launch materials for a product marketer, or a technical explanation for another engineering team. It chooses the format and timing, then delivers the approved material in Slack. Nobody has to ask it to start. We’re beginning with hands-on deployments, learning how each company works and where people depend on one another. That understanding will let Memoir expand beyond p

yc_perfectbit-inc.name: PerfectBit, Inc.
yc_perfectbit-inc.description: PerfectBit builds learned policies for robots that do real work. We train manipulation and control policies that hold up outside the lab, in the unstructured environments where real tasks actually happen. Founded by two alumni of Meta's Superintelligence org: Péter Vajda led Media GenAI foundation-model R&D (Emu, Movie Gen, image and video editing), and Seiji Yamamoto led teams in the Core Llama group across LLM pre-training and post-training, inference optimization, and computer vision. We're early, deliberately quiet about the details, and hiring the first researchers who will shape what this becomes. San Francisco, on-site.

yc_stage.name: Stage
yc_stage.tagline: Code review platform for humans and agents
yc_stage.description: Stage is a new code review platform designed to help engineers better understand and review AI generated code. Engineering teams are shipping faster than ever with agents, but now they’re drowning in an endless backlog of PRs to review. Stage reorganizes the code review process around how engineers naturally think, enabling you to review (and merge!) PRs 5x faster. Used by top engineers at Legora, n8n, Branch, and more.

yc_standard-signal.name: Standard Signal
yc_standard-signal.tagline: Hedge fund where AI researches and executes every trade end-to-end
yc_standard-signal.description: Standard Signal is the first hedge fund that researches and executes trades purely with AI. Our custom models discover and trade on new fundamental truths about the world before humans can.

yc_primitive.name: primitive
yc_primitive.description: Building the communication infrastructure needed for fully autonomous agents

yc_klarify.name: Klarify
yc_klarify.description: Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients. Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it. Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients. Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today. Our mission is to empower

yc_surtr-defense-systems.name: Surtr Defense Systems
yc_surtr-defense-systems.tagline: The hardware-agnostic operating system for drone defense
yc_surtr-defense-systems.description: Surtr builds ParallaxOS, the open operating system for counter-UAS. It takes sensor data from any radar, RF detector, camera, or acoustic array and fuses it into a single unified picture with AI-driven threat classification and engagement recommendations. yc_martini.description: Martini is a collaborative, AI-native platform for professional filmmaking in the era of generative media. By integrating the best generative models into professional workflows, we enable world-class creatives to harness generative AI as a legitimate medium for film.

yc_litmus-hiring.name: Litmus
yc_litmus-hiring.description: Litmus is building the most accurate framework for evaluating and benchmarking human capability, starting with software. Litmus applies the same approach we already use for model evals to humans – creating world-like environments, and inspecting trajectory instead of just output. Every knowledge industry will soon face the same problem. We build Litmus to tell you what humans are capa

yc_condor-energy.description: Condor helps large electricity consumers - C&I and data centers - cut electricity costs by helping the grid. We are former electricity traders and energy physicists. yc_remix-3.name: Remix

yc_remix-3.description: Remix is the easiest way to create content with AI. Connect your accounts, drop in photos, voice notes, or messages, and Remix instantly creates posts in your style: articles, tweets, carousels, short-form videos, even content riffing on the latest trending formats. Chat with 100s of parallel AI agents that handle everything from picking your best photos to writing copy to applying edits, all at once. Instagram was the easiest way to create photos on mobile. yc_openvector.name: OpenVector

yc_openvector.description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. yc_wayco.name: Wayco
yc_wayco.description: Wayco is building a unified data intelligence layer for medical treatment of legal cases. From the first intake to instant settlement.

yc_applied-electrodynamics-inc.name: Applied Electrodynamics, Inc.

The same platform extends to security screening and cargo inspection. Our mission is to make the hidden physical world machine-readable across the entire electromagnetic spectrum.

yc_unifold.name: Unifold
yc_unifold.description: Launch crypto deposits in minutes. Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.

yc_carrot-labs.name: Carrot Labs
yc_carrot-labs.tagline: AI Cost Management: Track and attribute AI spend across every provider
yc_carrot-labs.description: The problem: AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it. Which customers are unprofitable once you subtract their AI costs? Which feature is quietly burning your Anthropic budget? Is this week's spike a runaway loop or real growth? How much did that AI-written PR actually cost to ship? Today teams reverse-engineer answers by exporting CSVs from each provider and stitching them together in

yc_dispatch.name: Dispatch
yc_dispatch.description: Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck. We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg To

yc_trybloom.description: Bloom is the brand layer for agents - it turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call. We're building brand-as-infrastructure for the AI era.

yc_aurorin-cad.description: There are 2 problems: The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart. yc_fixture.name: Fixture
yc_fixture.tagline: An AI-first CRM built for Startups
yc_fixture.description: Fixture is an AI-native CRM built for startups. Our AI agents proactively help you move your deals forward, and you can use Fixture from our web UI or any of your favorite AI tools (e.g. Claude Code).

yc_brumby.name: Brumby (Formerly GrazeMate)

yc_brumby.description: Brumby builds autonomous drones that herd cattle. On command, our drones fly to a paddock, position themselves around the mob, and move them where they need to go. yc_origami-robotics.description: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. Our AI control system enables specialized robots to collaborate, learn reusable construction skills, like alignment, fastening, and manipulation, and transfer them across workflows, from solar farms to data centers. 🚧 🦺

yc_ditto-biosciences.description: Ditto Bio discovers drugs for autoimmune diseases by harnessing parasite biology. yc_datoric.description: Datoric develops custom datasets for voice models, robotics, and world models, treating research, collection, verification, and production as one continuous process. yc_netter.name: Netter
yc_netter.tagline: AI native Palantir for mid market.
yc_netter.description: Netter (YC P26) helps companies regain control over their data, so teams can pilot their activities with high precision. yc_voxel-energy.name: Voxel Energy
yc_voxel-energy.tagline: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.
yc_voxel-energy.description: The best grid connection is no grid connection. yc_polymath.name: Polymath

Sandboxes and environments are startable within seconds and take milliseconds to reset.

yc_bubble-lab.name: Bubble Lab
yc_bubble-lab.description: Bubble Lab helps event organizers and professional communities turn a room full of people into meaningful connections. Attendee enrichment, matchmaking, searchable member directories, applications, payments, Luma and Slack sync, onboarding, and analytics all live in one place, so a single operator can run better gatherings and build a smarter community over time.

yc_pocket.name: Pocket

yc_byteport.name: Byteport
yc_byteport.description: Founded in 2025, Byteport is a technology company that builds mission-critical network infrastructure for robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications all over the world. Businesses of every size—from new startups to public companies—use our software to accelerate file transfer online.

yc_constellation-space.name: Constellation Space

yc_constellation-space.description: Constellation Space is building the autonomous infrastructure layer for the next generation of space networking. ConstellationOS bridges this gap by providing zero-intervention network handoffs, predictive thermal load-balancing, and sub-second optical routing. Our founding team spent years building and operating satellite systems at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA. We started Constellation to solve the problem we kept running into: reactive monitoring doesn't scale. We are building the sub-second routing protocols and hyperscale load-balancin

yc_sazabi.name: Sazabi
yc_sazabi.tagline: The AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams
yc_sazabi.description: The AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams. Backed by tastemakers from the world's top AI companies: Vercel, Graphite, Daytona, Browserbase, LangChain, Mastra, Replit, and more.

yc_axionorbital-space.name: AxionOrbital Space
yc_axionorbital-space.description: AxionOrbital Space builds foundation models that enable continuous visibility through clouds and darkness. yc_oximy.name: Oximy
yc_oximy.tagline: Take command of the AI your company already runs on.
yc_oximy.description: Oximy is one platform to see every AI tool and dollar across your company, run your team’s work in an app you own, and route every request to the right model.

yc_caretta.name: Caretta
yc_caretta.description: Caretta is a Sales Intelligence for revenue teams. It joins reps in live calls, helping them handle information requests, questions, and objections in real time. yc_samora-ai.name: Samora AI
yc_samora-ai.tagline: Multilingual voice agents that outperform humans
yc_samora-ai.description: Samora runs multilingual voice operations for organizations with high-volume calling without requiring engineering teams, call centers, or AI expertise. But voice AI often fails in production because real callers interrupt, go off-script, switch languages mid-sentence, and speak in local dialects. Teams also worry about safety and compliance, especially when an agent can accidentally make the wrong promise. Samora solves this with voice agents that sound local and follow strict rules. Samora agents handle inbound and outbound calls, collect information, and update intern

yc_human-archive.description: Human Archive (YC W26) is building the data and deployments infrastructure for physical AI. yc_robby.name: Robby

yc_usereframe.name: Reframe

yc_maywood.name: Maywood
